jobs.description: Job Title: Junior BIM & Digital Twin Modeler (m/f/d) – Existing Building Digitization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time (Junior / Fresh Graduate / 1–2 Years Experience) Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit is an independent German research institute dedicated to advancing sustainable transformation, digital resilience, and automated building modeling. In close cooperation with academic institutions and industry partners in Germany, IRIS develops applied data models, digital building twins, and ESG evaluation frameworks. To scale our technical operations, we are establishing our engineering hub in Karachi. Role Overview In this role, you will be part of our core modeling desk responsible for transforming legacy building documentation from Germany into intelligent, standardized digital building twins. You will work closely with architectural and engineering specifications to establish accurate base models according to European engineering criteria. Key Responsibilities - Analyze and evaluate German historical building documentation, architectural archives, 2D CAD plans, and section drawings. - Generate precise parametric 3D Building Information Models (BIM) according to German DIN 277 standards (area and volume calculations). - Enrich digital models with structural properties, building envelope data, and technical building equipment (HVAC/TGA). - Export and validate standard IFC building models for downstream sustainability and energy modeling. - Maintain structured version control and documentation of processed building files. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Architectural Drafting, or a related technical discipline (NED University, DUET, or equivalent). - Proven practical experience with Autodesk Revit, ArchiCAD, or AutoCAD (academic project work or 1–2 years practical experience). - Strong technical understanding of floor plans, elevations, wall compositions, and construction details. - High level of precision, attention to structural numbers, and a structured working style. - Good proficiency in English (written and spoken); enthusiasm to learn basic technical German terminology is welcome. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Compensation: Attractive local salary package aligned with standard Karachi tech/engineering benchmarks. - Modern Work Environment: Modern, fully equipped, air-conditioned office in DHA with reliable power backup and dedicated workstations. - Long-Term In-Country Career Path: For professionals who wish to build their career locally, we offer stable advancement to Quality Lead, Senior Modeler, and Team Leader, alongside continuous professional training in European standards, modern BIM methodologies, and further academic qualification opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): For high-performing team members who consistently demonstrate outstanding precision and reliability over 3 to 6 months, we provide the opportunity to qualify for a sponsored research transfer to Germany under § 18d AufenthG (Researcher Visa). This includes comprehensive support with visa processing, relocation logistics, and housing support / accommodation assistance in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-trainee@iris-institut.info

Job Title: Data Extraction & Pipeline Engineer (m/f/d) – Web Scraping & Market Intelligence Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-DATA-04 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-DATA-04 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit develops intelligent data systems to observe, evaluate, and forecast market and sustainability developments across Europe. Our data pipelines extract and synthesize complex public, municipal, and real estate market indices into unified analytical models. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Backend & Data Extraction Engineer to design, deploy, and monitor scalable web crawlers, data scrapers, and data ingestion pipelines handling diverse, unstructured web sources. Key Responsibilities - Architect and maintain robust scraping and crawling pipelines targeting property portals, public registers, municipal gazettes, and economic data sources. - Implement parsing, data normalization, deduplication, and quality-validation routines for incoming raw data. - Manage proxy rotation, anti-bot mechanisms, rate limiting, and headless browser workflows. - Store and organize structured information using PostgreSQL, Redis, and document stores. - Package data services into Docker containers and interface them with internal analytics engines via REST/GraphQL APIs. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology (e.g., FAST-NUCES, NED University, or equivalent). - Hands-on experience developing web scraping frameworks in Python: Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, BeautifulSoup, or Puppeteer. - Practical knowledge of relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL/caching databases (Redis, MongoDB). - Experience with Linux environments, Docker, and Git. - Structured problem-solving mindset, persistence with complex web structures, and solid English skills. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Package: Excellent compensation package aligned with regional developer salaries. - Modern Workspace: Air-conditioned, reliable office in DHA Phase 1/2 with generator backup. - Local Leadership Path: Opportunities to scale into Engineering Lead / Data Operations Manager as the Karachi hub grows, supported by ongoing technical mentorship and European project workflows. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Top-performing engineers with consistent code quality and reliability over 3–6 months can transition to our research development institute in Germany under the § 18d researcher framework, complete with full visa sponsorship, relocation assistance, and housing / accommodation support. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-scraping@iris-institut.info

Job Title: Geospatial & Remote Sensing Data Engineer (m/f/d) – Satellite Analytics Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-GEO-03 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-GEO-03 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit conducts research into sustainable land use, environmental resilience, and automated parcel due diligence. Our geospatial research unit develops automated analytical tools that leverage satellite imagery, open geodata, and topography models to assess real estate sites and environmental factors. Role Overview In this role, you will design and implement data pipelines to process multi-spectral satellite imagery, digital elevation models (DEM), and municipal cadastral layers to evaluate site topography, ground sealing, and solar potential. Key Responsibilities - Build automated ETL pipelines to ingest and process satellite data (Copernicus/Sentinel, Landsat) and aerial imagery. - Process Digital Surface Models (DSM) and Digital Elevation Models (DEM) to calculate slope, terrain contouring, and building heights. - Match spatial parcel boundaries (ALKIS/OpenStreetMap) with satellite feature extractions using spatial databases. - Develop algorithmic scripts for rooftop solar potential calculation and environmental risk mapping (e.g., heat islands, flood zones). - Maintain spatial databases and expose analysis results via structured REST APIs. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Surveying, GIS, Computer Science, or equivalent. - Strong programming skills in Python utilizing geospatial libraries: GeoPandas, Shapely, Rasterio, GDAL/OGR, or PyProj. - Solid experience with QGIS and spatial relational databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS). - Familiarity with satellite data platforms (Google Earth Engine, Copernicus Open Access Hub, or Sentinel Hub) is an advantage. - Good command of spoken and written English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary structure reflecting technical specialization. - Professional Equipment & Infrastructure: Modern workstation in DHA, Karachi, equipped with high-bandwidth connections and uninterrupted power supply. - Career Growth: Long-term advancement to Senior GIS Architect / Data Lead in Karachi, with access to collaborative international research projects, European geodata publications, and conference opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Candidates demonstrating outstanding analytical achievements over 3–6 months are eligible for our German research mobility track (§ 18d AufenthG), including dedicated relocation guidance and housing / accommodation support in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-geo@iris-institut.info

Job Title: Computational Scenario & Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d) – Real Estate Optimization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-ALGO-05 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-ALGO-05 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit conducts scientific and applied research into algorithmic decision-making, automated site feasibility, and sustainable structural optimization. We combine spatial constraints, regulatory boundaries, and construction metrics to computationally model future-proof development scenarios. Role Overview As a Computational Algorithm Engineer, you will develop mathematical models and algorithmic scripts that simulate alternative building layouts, floor area ratios (BGF/BRI), and economic optimization scenarios for land parcels. Key Responsibilities - Develop computational logic to simulate building massing, setback constraints, and maximum buildable volumes based on parcel geometries. - Build mathematical evaluation models for multivariate scenario comparisons (e.g., Best-Case vs. Middle-Case commercial vs. mixed-use developments). - Interlink spatial building volumes with structured construction cost indices (German DIN 276 cost groups) to generate dynamic cost models. - Create parameter scripts and automated reporting outputs for feasibility analysis. - Collaborate closely with BIM modelers, data engineers, and research directors. Requirements & Qualifications - Degree in Computational Design, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Computational Engineering, or Architecture with an intensive programming focus. - Strong proficiency in Python, C#, or TypeScript; familiarity with computational geometry libraries or parametric modeling (Grasshopper/Rhino.Compute) is highly advantageous. - Solid mathematical foundations in optimization algorithms, geometry processing, and multivariate numerical analysis. - Ability to translate architectural planning regulations into structured code constraints. - Fluent written and verbal communication in English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Compensation: Top-tier local remuneration reflecting algorithmic and computational expertise. - Modern Work Hub: Reliable, modern, air-conditioned workspace in DHA Karachi with high-speed fiber infrastructure and power backup. - Sustainable Career Track: Clear promotion tracks into Algorithm Lead or Scientific Computing Lead in Karachi, with ongoing exposure to European construction standards, research publications, and advanced modeling systems. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Outstanding candidates demonstrating mathematical rigor and successful delivery over 3–6 months can qualify for direct transfer to Germany as a Research Associate under § 18d AufenthG, including dedicated administrative assistance, visa handling, and housing / accommodation support on-site. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-ai@iris-institut.info

jobs.description: CENIS ist seit über 40 Jahren ein erfahrener Partner für hochwertige Personaldienstleistungen und individuelle Karrierewege. Wir unterstützen Fach- und Führungskräfte dabei, den Job zu finden, der wirklich zu ihnen passt, mit fairen Konditionen und einem Mehrwert für alle beteiligten Parteien.Dank unseres starken Netzwerks vermitteln wir insbesondere qualifizierte Positionen im Engineering, in der IT sowie im kaufmännischen Umfeld ndash; insbesondere in Branchen wie Luft- und Raumfahrt (Aviation), Maschinenbau, Automotive, Chemie, Medizin- und Energietechnik sowie der öffentlichen Verwaltung. Gemeinsam mit Ihnen gestalten wir Ihren nächsten Karriereschritt.Das bieten wir:- Wir suchen Ihren Job nach Ihren Vorstellungen- Attraktives Arbeitsumfeld mit guten Übernahmechancen- Festanstellung bei CENIS gemäß GVP/DGB-Tarifvertrag- Ab dem ersten Tag Vergütung nach Equal Pay- Einsatzabhängige Sonderzahlungen, Zuschläge und Zuschüsse (z.B. This will give you a profile that you can use for all future applications, and you will be notified whenever a new position that matches your criteria becomes available.About Mitel:Mitel is a global market leader in business communications, powering more than two billion connections every day. With customers in over 100 countries, we help organizations modernize their communications, strengthen collaboration, and deliver exceptional experiences. Our culture is built on innovation, integrity, and empowering our people to do their best work. At Mitel, you’ll join a team that values trust, encourages fresh thinking, and embraces diverse perspectives to drive meaningful impact. Overview:In this senior role you will lead the Local & Direct Sales Procurement Team and report to the global Chief Procurement Officer. You will also have considerable interaction with your peer the Head of Global & Strategic Procurement and a wide base of non-Procurement stakeholders.This is a high-profile role with direct & significant impact on a complex global business and you will be expected to build strong & deep relationships with large numbers of stakeholders at all levels within & outside Mitel so that you understand what is required for their success and your stakeholders understand the role and value driven by your team - as a result significant complexity, personal responsibility, workload & working hour flexibility should be expected. jobs.employer_name: Deutsches Institut für Ernährungsforschung Stiftung des öffentl.Rechts
jobs.description: The German Institute of Human Nutrition Potsdam-Rehbruecke (DIfE) (https://www.dife.de/) is a member of the Leibniz Association. The institute’s mission is to conduct experimental and clinical research in the field of nutrition and health, with the aim of understanding the molecular basis of nutrition-dependent diseases, and of developing new strategies for treatment and prevention.The Department Molecular Physiology of Exercise and Nutrition (MPEN) (https://www.dife.de/forschung/abteilungen-und-forschungsgruppen/molekulare-physiologie-der-bewegung-und-ernaehrung/) is inviting applications for1 Doctoral Student (m/f/d)starting as soon as possible.Project descriptionThis project investigates the regulation and metabolic fate of short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) in the liver, with a particular focus on their role in metabolic health and fatty liver disease. Using mouse models, cell culture systems, and state-of-the-art metabolic approaches, we aim to understand the mechanisms governing hepatic SCFA uptake and how these processes are regulated by nutritional states, including fasting and feeding, and altered under pathological conditions such as metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). A central focus of the project is to determine the intracellular fate of SCFAs, investigating when they serve as energy substrates, building blocks for anabolic processes, or regulators of gene expression through epigenetic modifications. By combining in vivo and in vitro experiments with stable isotope tracing and metabolic flux analysis, we aim to uncover how hepatic SCFA metabolism is regulated and how it contributes to liver function and metabolic disease.Specifically, the candidate will:- Plan and perform in vivo metabolic experiments in mice to investigate hepatic SCFA uptake, metabolism, and substrate utilization under different nutritional and disease conditions.- Design and conduct stable isotope tracing experiments, both in vivo and in cultured cells, to characterize SCFA uptake, intracellular metabolic fluxes, and incorporation into downstream metabolites and cellular components.- Establish and perform cell culture experiments, including work with primary hepatocytes, to investigate the molecular mechanisms controlling SCFA metabolism.- Investigate the contribution of SCFAs to energy metabolism, anabolic pathways, and epigenetic modifications, including histone acylation.- Perform downstream molecular and biochemical analyses of tissues and biological samples, including metabolomics, protein analyses, and measurements of metabolic intermediates.- Contribute to the management and maintenance of mouse colonies, including breeding, genotyping, and experimental planning.Requirements and Skills- A master's degree in biochemistry, molecular biology, physiology, nutritional sciences, or a related discipline.- Prior hands-on experience with stable isotope tracing and metabolic flux analysis is a key requirement for this position.- A strong background in intermediary metabolism, particularly hepatic glucose, lipid, or fatty acid metabolism.- Practical experience with cell culture techniques and molecular and biochemical assays.- Experience with mass spectrometry-based metabolomics and the analysis of isotope labeling data is an advantage.- Strong analytical skills, scientific curiosity, and the ability to plan and conduct experiments independently.- Excellent communication skills in English and a collaborative approach to research.We offer:- Intensive scientific support, close collaboration with cooperating institutions and enrolment in a local PhD program- Excellent technical equipment, a wide range of experimental methods and a dynamic and interactive research environment- Remuneration according to TV-L, level 13 (65 %), plus annual special payment and company pension scheme- Family-friendly working conditions (certificate “audit berufundfamilie”)- Supporting of mobility with a jobticket for using the public transport- Easy accessibility by public transport or car (including free parking)- 30 days of vacation- Participation in the benefits program for employees („Corporate Benefits“)The advertised position is available for 3 years.We promote the employment of people with severe disabilities and are committed to equal opportunities for them. Applicants with severe disabilities will be given preferential consideration if they have the same qualifications.We look forward to your application!Please send your documents (cover letter explaining your motivation, CV, copies of degrees/certificates and references) as a single pdf-file before November 25th, 2026 via e-mail to jobs@dife.de.For further information please do not hesitate to contact:Prof. Dr. Maximilian KleinertHead of Department Molecular Physiology of Exercise and NutritionE-Mail: Maximilian.Kleinert@dife.deWe process your application documents for the purpose of carrying out the application procedure in accordance with Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b) GDPR, Art. 88 GDPR. For more information on the collection, processing and use of personal data by the German Institute of Human Nutrition as part of the application process and your rights under data protection law, please contact the Department of Human Resources and Social Services (jobs@dife.de).

jobs.occupation: Veterinarian (m/f/d) for our Veterinary Laboratory (Tierarzt/-ärztin - Groß- und Nutztiere)
jobs.description: ... part-time or full-timeMicroscopy, counting cells, solving challenging questions and identifying hidden pathogens: In our veterinary laboratory, you will make an important contribution to rapid diagnostics and, therefore, to providing our animal patients with the best possible care. As a veterinarian working alongside your doctoral position at another institution, you will work closely with our team, stay closely connected to the clinical environment and gain exciting insights into diagnoses and treatment courses. As rapid results are often essential in a clinical setting, you will also keep a cool head in demanding situations.If you are driven by a spirit of scientific curiosity, value precise work, would like to help animals and want to enrich our laboratory team with your veterinary expertise, we look forward to receiving your application for our in-house laboratory.Working in our laboratory offers you, as a veterinarian completing the professional recognition period, the opportunity to specifically apply the veterinary knowledge you have already acquired in the field of laboratory diagnostics while gaining an in-depth insight into clinical diagnostics and the resulting treatment decisions. You will work closely with experienced veterinarians and gain first-hand experience of how laboratory findings contribute to the assessment and care of our patients.The position is particularly aimed at veterinarians who have already completed their degree, have gained initial practical experience in veterinary laboratory diagnostics and would like to combine a position in our laboratory with their ongoing doctoral research at another institution for at least 12 months. In this role, you will combine your doctoral position with a professionally demanding position and have the opportunity to continuously deepen your knowledge in hematology, clinical chemistry, cytology, microscopy and other areas of laboratory diagnostics.Our modern laboratory enables comprehensive and rapid diagnostics around the clock, including at night and on weekends. Many test results are available within just 15 to 30 minutes and can be used immediately for diagnostics, treatment and intensive care.Our diagnostic spectrum includes, among other things, hematological and clinical chemistry analyses, blood gas and coagulation analyses, urinalyses, as well as rapid tests for infectious diseases and hormone determinations. Another focus is the microscopic examination and assessment of blood, urine and fecal samples, as well as cytological diagnostics of body cavity effusions, fine-needle aspirates and joint aspirates. In particular, intraoperative rapid diagnostics often help enable well-founded treatment decisions to be made promptly.Your Profile- You have successfully completed your degree in Veterinary Medicine and are currently pursuing a doctoral degree at another institution.- You would like to work in our veterinary laboratory for at least 12 months alongside your doctoral position and gain extensive experience in clinical laboratory diagnostics.- Ideally, you have initial practical experience in veterinary laboratory diagnostics, microscopy or sample processing.- You are interested in hematological, clinical chemistry and cytological questions and enjoy carefully assessing findings and identifying diagnostic connections.- You work precisely, independently and responsibly and are able to maintain an overview even when handling a high volume of samples and time-critical examinations.- You enjoy working closely with experienced veterinarians and our entire laboratory team.- Good German skills are an advantage, but are not a prerequisite. Very good English skills at C1 level are equally welcome for this position.- You enjoy further developing your veterinary knowledge in a clinical setting and learning about the connection between laboratory findings, diagnostics and treatment.Your Responsibilities- Analysis of a wide range of samples from our outpatient and inpatient patients- Performing and assessing laboratory diagnostic examinations as part of our in-house diagnostics- Microscopy: differential blood count including staining, ear cytology and urine sediment examination- Performing and assessing specialized examinations such as body cavity effusion analysis, synovial fluid analysis and platelet assessment- Assessing and interpreting laboratory findings in close collaboration with our medical team- Supporting the timely provision and interpretation of findings for diagnostics, treatment and intensive care- Collaboration with and shipment of samples to external laboratories (IDEXX, Antech, Laboklin and others)- Ordering of consumables and laboratory supplies- Billing of examinations and external services in Vetera- Close collaboration with our medical team and gaining insight into clinical decision-making processes- Communication with pet owners and referring veterinariansYour Working HoursIt is important to us that your working day can be planned reliably. Our laboratory is therefore organized in such a way that overtime is generally not required. Should overtime nevertheless arise, it will of course be compensated with time off. Electronic time tracking ensures transparency and reliable documentation of your working hours.The position can be filled on a part-time basis with 12 to 30 hours per week. If you are interested in additionally working in one of our other veterinary departments, we would also be happy to employ you on a full-time basis.If you would like to support us four days per week, you can take on more responsible and increasingly independent tasks in our laboratory, as these require a greater time commitment as well as a certain level of routine in the workflows.The position is particularly suitable for veterinarians who would like to combine their doctoral research at another institution with intensive practical experience in laboratory diagnostics. Through close collaboration with our medical team, you will also gain a comprehensive insight into clinical contexts and can specifically further develop your veterinary knowledge.Your working hours will be distributed evenly between early and late shifts. Early shifts start at 7:30 a.m., while late shifts end at 8:00 p.m. In addition, you will work at least one weekend per month from 11:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.Please state in your cover letter your possible working hours and when you would be available to start working with us.CompensationAs a veterinary clinic, our compensation is based on our veterinary remuneration structures. Please include your salary expectations in your cover letter.Would you like to learn more about us? Here you can find out (https://www.tierklinik-ismaning.de/ueber-die-tierklinik-ismaning/jobs/ihr-neuer-job/)  what distinguishes us as an employer and what employee benefits we offer.The position can be started immediately, or at a later date by agreement.

jobs.description: SummaryImagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas quickly become extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. Bring passion and dedication to your job, and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Smart people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here.Our team is responsible for validating the RF performance of top-notch, monolithic, cellular transceivers and the RF subsystems built around them. In order to expand our team's validation capability towards future Apple products, we are looking for a passionate RF engineer with strong RF transceiver system understanding, complemented by AI/ML and programming skills. You will work in an agentic engineering flow — scoping the problem and defining pass/fail criteria, delegating implementation and execution to AI agents, and verifying every result against the specification — applying innovative AI/ML-based methods to advance our measurement and analysis capabilities and to scale our regression environment. jobs.occupation: Doctoral Researcher (f_m_x) - Forest Carbon Attribution from Earth Observation and Atmospheric Const (Geowissenschaftler/in)
jobs.description: The GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences is one of the world's leading institutions in the field of geosciences. As part of the Helmholtz Association, Germany's largest research organisation, we address global challenges such as natural hazards, climate change and the sustainable use of resources. In doing so, we combine cutting-edge research with social relevance. Our international staff - around 1,200 employees and approx. 500 guests - work in a multidisciplinary way and with a unique infrastructure to research the dynamic processes of the Earth system. Our vision: “Taking the pulse of the Earth to safeguard a habitable planet.”For section 1.4 Remote Sensing and Geoinformatics (https://www.gfz.de/en/section/remote-sensing-and-geoinformatics/overview) (department “Geodesy” (https://www.gfz.de/en/departments/geodesy) ), we are looking for a:Doctoral Researcher (f_m_x) - Forest Carbon Attribution from Earth Observation and Atmospheric ConstraintsReference Number 11590Many countries rely on forests to meet their climate targets, but how much of the forest carbon sink is real, and how much depends on management and disturbance, remains largely unverified. This PhD will combine satellite observations, carbon-cycle models, and atmospheric measurements to build an independent picture of forests’ actual role in the climate.This position is part of EUFOR-G3W, a Horizon Europe project contributing to the WMO Global Greenhouse Gas Watch (G3W). EUFOR-G3W develops observation- and model-based products to quantify greenhouse-gas sources and sinks at global to national scales.Within the EUFOR-G3W project, GFZ contributes to the development and application of harmonised Earth Observation (EO) datasets to improve our understanding of forest carbon dynamics. The research focuses on forest biomass, age, disturbance history, and vegetation productivity, as well as their integration into the FLUXCOM-X empirical flux upscaling framework to better represent managed and recovering forests.The successful candidate will investigate how forest management, disturbances, and recovery processes influence the land CO₂ budget across different spatial and temporal scales. A particular focus will be on combining satellite-based observations with carbon flux estimates and assessing how atmospheric observations can independently constrain these contributions.The candidate will be supervised by GFZ and Wageningen University and Research (WUR), (https://www.wur.nl/en) in collaboration with Max Planck Institut for Biogeochemistry (MPI-BGC) Jena (https://www.bgc-jena.mpg.de/en) . They will work closely with a second PhD candidate in the group of Wouter Peters at WUR, Netherlands. Together, the two positions form a duo linking observations and models: the GFZ position focuses on translating Earth Observation data into forest carbon information, while the WUR position focuses on forest and atmospheric modelling and data assimilation. Your research will have direct relevance to international climate policy: Your results will feed into operational greenhouse-gas monitoring systems supporting the WMO Global Greenhouse Gas Watch and the Copernicus CO2 monitoring service. You will have access to a unique combination of global forest EO datasets, cloud-native analysis infrastructure, forest ecosystem models, and atmospheric inversion systems. And you will be in close collaboration with leading European groups at WUR and MPI-BGC Jena within the EUFOR-G3W consortium.Your responsibilities:- Translate high-resolution EO forest datasets (e.g. biomass, forest age, disturbance) into model-ready inputs for forest and atmospheric models, while preserving key spatial information- Quantify the contribution of forest management and disturbance to forest CO2 exchange using model simulations constrained by EO data- Assess how well atmospheric CO2 observations can independently constrain this signal across regions and timescales- Contribute to improving the representation of managed and recovering forests in data-driven flux products such as FLUXCOM-X- Derive national forest carbon budgets and compare them with greenhouse-gas inventory reporting- Publish results in peer-reviewed journals and present at international conferences and project meetingsAbout You:Essential Qualifications:- An MSc in Earth Sciences, Environmental Sciences, Physical Geography, Atmospheric Sciences, Remote Sensing, or a related quantitative field- Strong quantitative and data analysis skills- Proficiency in Python and experience with geospatial or large environmental datasets- Good written and spoken English- Ability to work in a collaborative, multi-institutional research environmentDesirable Qualifications:- Experience in terrestrial carbon cycle science, ecosystem modelling, or Earth Observation of forests- Familiarity with atmospheric inverse modelling or greenhouse-gas accounting frameworks- Experience with Xarray, Dask, or cloud-based geospatial data analysis- Knowledge of national greenhouse-gas inventories or LULUCF accountingWe do not expect applicants to be already experts across all three disciplines — Earth Observation, forest modelling, and atmospheric inversions. The position is specifically designed to bridge them.Start date: 1st February 2027Fixed-term: 36 Monate (extension to 4 years possible, subject to funding)Salary: Die Stelle ist nach TVöD Bund mit der Entgeltgruppe 13 bewertet. Die Eingruppierung erfolgt nach den tariflichen Bestimmungen und den entsprechenden persönlichen Voraussetzungen.Working hours: Teilzeit 75% (derzeit 29,25 h/Woche)Place of work: PotsdamWhat we offer:- Ambitious and varied tasks in a dynamic and international research environmentState-of-the-art equipment- Public service benefits- Extensive training opportunities- Professional career advice offered by our in-house Career-Centre- Flexible working hours and conditions- Support with finding a good work-life balance offered by benefit@work- Institute day-care centre on sites- Working at the Albert Einstein Science Park on the Telegrafenberg in Potsdam- Workplace within walking distance of Potsdam main train station, or just a short ride on the shuttle busHave we piqued your interest?If so, we look forward to receiving your application by 2nd December 2026. jobs.occupation: Staff Network Reliability Engineer (f/m/d) / 1610 (Site Reliability Engineer)
jobs.description: About IONOSAt IONOS, we don't just manage servers – we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure – from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools.What drives us is digital sovereignty for Europe and real impact for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) as well as large enterprises. We work in agile teams, rely on transparent structures, and believe that excellence and innovation only emerge through true team spirit.Ready for your next step? Become part of IONOS and grow with us.NRE Operations runs the data center networks for the entire IONOS group: the physical fabric and underlay, the SDN overlay, and the virtual network functions on top, across dozens of data centers. We are looking for a senior or staff-level engineer who operates large production networks with a reliability mindset. You define what "healthy" means, catch problems before customers do, lead the hardest incidents, and partner with NRE Automation to push routine operations toward zero manual steps. AI is central to how we work, both to make the network smarter and to make each engineer faster.We expect every engineer here to be fluent with AI, and we mean it in two concrete ways. First, applying AI to the network itself: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis and root-cause analysis, config generation and validation, smarter alerting, and runbook or agent-driven automation. Second, using AI to raise your own output: coding assistants and LLM tooling for scripting, troubleshooting, research, and documentation. Reliability work punishes blind trust, so the skill that matters most is judgment. You need to know when an AI-generated config or diagnosis is trustworthy and when it is not.Tasks- Own reliability of the physical fabric, SDN overlay, and virtual network functions across all IONOS data centers. Set service level objectives and drive down unplanned downtime.- Lead incident response on major network incidents and run postmortems that produce lasting fixes.- Remove toil through automation, working with NRE Automation on pipelines and tooling for lifecycle, patching, and service configuration.- Apply AI to operations: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis, config generation and validation, and automated remediation, with the judgment to know when AI output is trustworthy.- Strengthen observability so problems surface before they reach customers, and shape lifecycle, upgrade, change-management, and capacity practices.- Collaborate with NRE Provisioning on clean handovers.- Share the on-call rotation covering the above.Qualifications- Extensive hands-on experience operating large-scale production data center networks (5+ years for Senior, longer for Staff).- Deep Layer 2 and Layer 3 knowledge: routing (BGP, OSPF) and VXLAN with BGP/EVPN.- Multi-vendor operations across Juniper and Cisco; SONiC and Netbox familiarity is a plus.- Strong Linux fundamentals and the toolkit that goes with them (bash, tcpdump, iptables, git).- Network automation you have built, using Python with Ansible and CI/CD on GitLab.- A reliability-engineering mindset: SLOs, observability, incident command, postmortems, designing out toil.- Fluent, critical use of AI in daily engineering, plus a track record or credible ideas for applying AI to network operations.- Fluent English for international teams; German is a plus. Ownership and a calm approach when things break.Benefits- Hybrid working model.- Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.- At some locations a subsidized canteen and various free drinks.- Modern office space with very good transport connections.- Various employee discounts for activities and products.- Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.- Numerous training and development opportunities.- Various health offers, such as sports and health courses.

jobs.occupation: Doctoral Researcher (m/f/d) in the Collaborative Project SiProtect (Molekularbiologe/-biologin)
jobs.description: Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN)  headquartered in Frankfurt am Main is seeking to fill the following position at its Senckenberg German Entomological Institute (SDEI) in Müncheberg  starting as of 1 January 2027Doctoral Researcher (m/f/d) in the Collaborative Project SiProtect(part time, 65%)Location: Müncheberg (Brandenburg)Employment scope: part-time, 65% (26 weekly working hours)Type of contract: ideally starting on 01 January 2027; fixed term until 31 December 2030Remuneration: collective agreement of the German Länder, TV-L E 13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.Located east of Berlin, the Senckenberg German Entomological Institute (SDEI) is situated on a modern science campus. An international team of scientists conducts insect research, complemented by an information centre with archive and library.About the projectExploring insect communities with molecular tools. How do crop resilience strategies affect insect communities - and how can molecular technologies help us monitor these changes directly in the field?As a PhD Researcher in the collaborative project SiProtect, you will investigate insect communities associated with rye and contribute to the development of innovative approaches for species identification and biodiversity monitoring.SiProtect explores how amorphous silicate (ASi) can strengthen rye resilience to biotic and abiotic stressors, including insect pests, associated pathogens and drought. Your research will connect field-based entomological monitoring with molecular identification, metabarcoding and portable nanopore sequencing.A particular focus will be the development and validation of a low-cost, portable molecular laboratory based on Oxford Nanopore MinION technology. The resulting workflow aims to accelerate species identification under field conditions and provide a transferable approach for sustainable crop protection and biodiversity monitoring.Your tasks- Plan and conduct entomological research activities within the SiProtect research programme, with a focus on insect communities associated with rye- Conduct standardised insect monitoring using Malaise traps, pan traps, sticky traps and sweep netting- Identify collected insects using morphological and taxonomic approaches and contribute to a reference database for rye-associated insect communities- Establish, optimise and validate metabarcoding approaches for bulk insect samples and compare their performance with conventional identification methods- Portable sequencing: Develop and validate a low-cost, portable molecular laboratory based on Oxford Nanopore MinION sequencing for rapid field-based species identification- Develop and apply computational pipelines for molecular species identification and insect community analysis- Assess responses of pest and beneficial insect communities to rye resilience strategies and integrate morphological and molecular monitoring data- Contribute to interdisciplinary research within the SiProtect consortium and develop new approaches for sustainable crop protection and biodiversity monitoring- Publish research findings in international journals and present results at scientific conferences and project meetingsYour profile- Completed Master’s degree in entomology, biology, ecology, molecular biology, biodiversity research or a related discipline- Good knowledge of the major insect orders and families of the German fauna and experience using taxonomic identification literature- Basic practical experience in molecular biology, ideally including DNA extraction, polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and gel documentation- Interest in and ideally initial experience with DNA barcoding, metabarcoding or molecular species identification- Basic programming skills in R and/or Python- Experience handling dried or ethanol-preserved entomological specimens is an advantage- Ability to organize research activities independently and work in a structured and reliable manner- Strong communication skills and an interest in interdisciplinary and collaborative research- Valid Class B driving licence and willingness to undertake fieldwork- Good written and spoken English, German skills are an advantageWhat you can expectThis position offers the opportunity to combine field entomology, molecular biology, metabarcoding, nanopore sequencing and bioinformatics within an interdisciplinary research project. You will contribute to a scientifically relevant question at the interface of crop resilience, biodiversity and sustainable agriculture, while developing a transferable methodological approach for field-based insect monitoring.We look forward to welcoming a curious and collaborative researcher who is keen to develop new methods and contribute their own ideas to SiProtect.We offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.Would you like to apply?If so, please upload your complete and detailed application materials (cover letter, current resume, copies of your educational and employment certificates, if available) in electronic form as a single PDF file by 22 November 2026  to the careers page on our website:https://www.senckenberg.de/de/stellenanzeigen/﻿Please note that applications for this position can only be accepted if they are submitted via our online application portal. This ensures that your application is processed correctly and can be considered as part of the selection procedure. Applications sent by email to the recruiting team or directly to individual staff members cannot be considered.For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/For further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung please visit www.senckenberg.deContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainIf you have any technical questions regarding the position, please feel free to contact Dr. Lara-Sophie Dey at lara-sophie.dey@senckenberg.de.For any questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact us atrecruiting@senckenberg.de.

jobs.description: The GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences is one of the world's leading institutions in the field of geosciences. As part of the Helmholtz Association, Germany's largest research organisation, we address global challenges such as natural hazards, climate change and the sustainable use of resources. In doing so, we combine cutting-edge research with social relevance. Our international staff - around 1,200 employees and approx. 500 guests - work in a multidisciplinary way and with a unique infrastructure to research the dynamic processes of the Earth system. Our vision: “Taking the pulse of the Earth to safeguard a habitable planet.”For section 1.2 Global Geomonitoring and Gravity (https://www.gfz.de/en/section/global-geomonitoring-and-gravity-field/overview) Field (department"Geodesy" (https://www.gfz.de/en/departments/geodesy) ), we are looking for a:Doctoral researcher (f_m_x) – Terrestrial and Cryo-Hydrological GravimetryReference Number 11591The GFZ department "Geodesy" has five independent sections that together advance the goals of the Helmholtz research programme "Changing Earth - Sustaining our Future" and provide important GFZ services and infrastructure within the Modular Earth Science Infrastructure (MESI). With this call, we are looking for a PhD student for section 1.2 "Global Geomonitoring and Gravity Field". This section focuses on developing and operating infrastructure for gravity field observations from global to local scales, with applications spanning geodynamic and climatic processes, water budgets, and hazard monitoring.The PhD position is part of the ERC Synergy Grant Project "SnowShifts - Current and future shifts of snow regimes in extreme environments" (https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101224858) seeking to significantly enhance our comprehension of snow volume and mass, their non-linear dynamics and properties and, specifically, snow regime shifts within the Earth and climate systems. The PhD student will be embedded in a highly vibrant team of PhD students and Postdocs from the project partners at the University of Oslo, BOKU Vienna, EPFL Lausanne and CNRS CESBIO Toulouse. The PhD student will be responsible for high-resolution snow mass quantification at local scales based on superconducting gravimetry at focus sites in high mountains (Zugspitze, Lhasa) and polar regions (Ny-Ålesund, Syowa, Jang Bogo). The joint analysis of terrestrial and satellite gravimetry will be carried out in a team with a Postdoc who will be responsible for the quantification of regional snow mass variations using spatio-temporally downscaled data from the GRACE/GRACE-FO and the upcoming GRACE-C satellite missions.Your responsibilities:- Process and analyse time series of temporal gravity variations from superconducting gravimeters- Implement a state-of-the-art toolbox for processing superconducting gravimeter time series- Quantify snow water equivalent variations based on superconducting gravimeter time series- Work on the gravimetric subproject in SnowShifts with personal responsibility and highly interdisciplinary cooperation with the external project partners from cryospheric sciences and remote sensing as well as colleagues from GFZ- Write scientific publications and present results at project meetings and conferences- Prepare a PhD thesisAbout You:Essential Qualifications:- Completed academic university degree (master's, diploma or equivalent) in Geodesy, Geophysics, Geosciences, Physics or a similar subject- Knowledge of temporal gravity field variations and their observation from space and from the Earth's surface- Experience in time series analyses and statistics- Good programming skills, e.g. in Python, MATLAB, FORTRAN- Ability and willingness for fieldwork in high-alpine and polar regions- Good communication and interpersonal skills- Very good command of EnglishDesirable Qualifications:- Knowledge of the German languageStart date: 1st February 2027Fixed-term: 3 JahreSalary: Die Stelle ist nach TVöD Bund mit der Entgeltgruppe 13 bewertet. jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day You join a team that is being built right now. Transformation of Industry is setting up a dedicated Function Controlling for the first time, and you are part of it from the start. On 25 August 2026 Siemens Energy announced preparations for the legal and operational separation of Transformation of Industry into a standalone company, a fast-growing business with around 17,000 employees, €6 billion of revenue and a double-digit profit margin. A standalone company needs its own transparency on the cost of its central functions — and that is exactly what this team delivers.You begin the day by reviewing the latest forecast for one of TI's central functions. Headcount, external spend and project costs have moved, and the functional leadership team needs a clear view of the financial impact. You discuss the key drivers, challenge assumptions and agree on actions. Later, you prepare the monthly performance review, coordinate inputs with local controllers and work with colleagues on a more efficient reporting solution. You are close to the business, comfortable with detail and able to turn numbers into a concise management message.This is a rare moment to join. A new company is being built, and with it a new Finance organization: the central Business Controlling team of Transformation of Industry is developing into the Corporate FP&A department of that company, an organization of more than 100 finance professionals. Within it, the Function Controlling team is defining common standards for planning, reporting, performance management and allocations — and you help shape them while owning the day-to-day business partnering for your functions. In this position you report directly to the Head of Function ControllingHow You’ll Make an Impact * Act as Finance Business Partner for corporate functions such as IT, HR, Communications, Legal & Compliance, Procurement or Finance, supporting their leaders in financial and performance decisions* Coordinate budgeting, forecasting, monthly closing and mid-term planning for assigned functions, ensuring alignment with local and regional controllers* Analyze cost, headcount, project and resource developments, explain deviations, identify risks and opportunities, and ensure consistent planning, reporting and data quality* Prepare management reports, performance reviews and decision-support materials, and support business cases, investment assessments and ad-hoc analyses for functional initiatives* Challenge spending plans and identify, quantify and track efficiency measures, supporting sound financial decisions and effective resource allocation* Develop allocation, charging and governance concepts, and improve controlling processes through standardization, automation and digital reportingWhat You Bring* A university degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Industrial Engineering or a related field* Longstanding experience in controlling, FP&A, cost controlling, function controlling or finance business partnering, with solid knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, cost center controlling and variance analysis* An analytical and structured approach, combining attention to detail with a clear understanding of the broader business context* A proactive, hands-on attitude and the flexibility to work effectively in a changing organization with a high workload* Strong communication skills and the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively and follow topics through to resolution, combined with good Excel and PowerPoint skills; knowledge of SAP, Power BI, SAC or comparable tools is a plus* Fluent English; additional languages are an asset but not requiredAbout the TeamOur Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.You do not need to tick every box. If this role excites you and you bring most of it, we would like to hear from you.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

The team finds root cause and contributing factors, so Tesla can reduce field, production, and development issues. You work with design, manufacturing, quality, and other engineering teams, across vehicle and energy products, including current models and products still in development. We need an electrical engineer with industry experience, not a new graduate, to identify and characterize electrical failures. You use a multimeter, an oscilloscope, and other basic electrical test equipment to confirm the symptom, isolate the fault, and support root cause with Design, Manufacturing, and Quality. The right person is comfortable on the bench: probing boards, reading a schematic well enough to troubleshoot, and explaining what they found. Manufacturing experience is a strong plus. That includes production test, yield, process, or factory debug.?What You’ll Do- Debug and troubleshoot analog and digital systems with a digital multimeter, oscilloscope, power supply, and related bench equipment. - Confirm and recreate failures seen in engineering, production, and the field. - Drive root cause from the first report toward a countermeasure, with the original design engineers and the other failure analysis engineers. - Use the analytical tools the case needs, including functional test, electrical debug, and X-ray. - Design experiments to test a theory, and run them yourself or with the technician. - Document findings and investigation status. Report root cause and the relevant facts to engineering and manufacturing. - Bring prior failure experience into design reviews and DFMEAs. - Partner with manufacturing on production and yield-related electrical issues that come into the lab.?What You’ll Bring- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience. - 1-3 years of industry experience in electrical debug, test, manufacturing, or a related hands-on role. We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. We want Smartly to be a place where people can do strong work, grow, and feel respected.Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We care about strong engineering fundamentals, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to build reliable systems with others. Direct experience with every technology listed here is less important than the judgment to learn, reason from first principles, and ship useful platform capabilities.About SmartlySmartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. jobs.occupation: Digital Guest Service / Customer Support Supervisor (all genders) Hospitality in Berlin (Reservierungssachbearbeiter/in (Hotel))
jobs.description: We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.Homaris exists to solve one of the most persistent problems in modern cities: People from abroad need places to live, work, and just feel at home. We build and operate fully digitised serviced apartments across Germany´s major cities – next step: Europe and beyond.And a product vision — the nanopartment® — that reimagines what urban stays can look like in the smallest possible space. Revenue triples within two years — organically. No venture capital. No exit strategy. We are in this for the long run, and we build accordingly. Extraordinary people make this happen - and we're looking for one more.Your RoleYou run the operational core of our digital guest service. Working from our Berlin headquarters, you join the Guest Service Supervisor team as the central point of contact for our Guest Service Agents worldwide. You make sure guests experience reliable care, and you free up the teams who speak with them every day. At the helm of our digital front desk, you keep every guest stay running smoothly behind the scenes.What You'll Do Operations. You support the Guest Service team in day-to-day work and keep our apartments running smoothly from behind the scenes.Quality. You design new quality concepts, monitor compliance with our standards in guest communication, and train the Agents continuously.Communication. You draft message templates that reach our guests reliably, personally and in the right tone.Second Level. You are the go-to contact for Agents when a case gets complex, and you take ownership when it matters most.Onboarding. You support the onboarding of new colleagues and the ongoing development of existing team members.Deputising. You cover for the Guest Service Team Lead during absences and keep the entire team in view.Interfaces. You coordinate closely with internal departments and external service partners, as a dependable partner who sees solutions through.What Makes You a Fit Service with Standards. You have a strong service mindset and are comfortable working at different times of day, including weekends on a regular, planned rotation.Experience. You bring professional experience as a Reservation Agent or Manager, Call Center Agent, Receptionist, or from another service-driven industry.Organisation. You organise and coordinate with confidence and approach problems with a solution-first mindset.Communication. You connect easily with different personalities and convey points of view, ideas and solutions clearly.Digital Tools. You work with software and digital solutions effortlessly. Experience with booking platforms and the property management systems Apaleo or Guesty is a plus.Languages. You speak and write German and English fluently (both at C1).Digital Curiosity. You spot potential in new tools and are excited about how AI can make your daily work more efficient.The EnvironmentHomaris is a company with the maximum of long-term orientation. We don't burn cash to grow fast and sell. We build something real, and we expect the people who join us to want to build it with us — not to optimise for others. The pace is high. The problems are real. The team is small enough that every person matters. We're not always great at seeing and celebrating our wins. But we're working on it — and we'd love your help with that.What We OfferWe define levels by the work you own and the decisions you're accountable for, not by your title or years of experience. Beyond that: we've thought carefully about what people actually need to do their best work and live well — and we've built a benefits package that reflects that. Health, mobility, development, flexibility, and a few perks that come with being in the travel and hospitality business. Not much is missing. We'll walk you through the details when we meet.Next StepsIf this opportunity resonates with you, we’d be glad to learn more about your experience and perspective. Just send us your CV.Questions? Reach out to Natalie at karriere@homaris.de or +49 157 92465807. We value diversity and welcome applications from people of all genders, cultures and backgrounds.About usHomaris is a leading provider of serviced nano-apartments in prime urban locations and is pioneering a new generation of space-efficient apartment concepts with its nanopartment®. With more than 4,500 apartments secured under contract in cities including Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, Cologne, Frankfurt, Stuttgart, Düsseldorf and Dresden, Homaris ranks among Germany’s leading serviced-apartment brands. The company serves contemporary customer segments, including business travellers, tourists, digital nomads and corporate clients.The Homaris concept is based on the integration of a fully digitalised guest journey with maximum space efficiency, multifunctional design and intelligent space solutions. The nanopartment® is Homaris’s signature product, embodying innovative space efficiency, modern minimalism and a modular design concept that combines living, working and a sense of arrival within a compact footprint. Rotating, folding and sliding mechanisms allow the space to be reconfigured according to individual needs. In the future, the system is intended to become a standard feature across Homaris’s upcoming properties.

Half your time goes to pipeline, which means finding the right accounts and people and building the plays that reach them; the other half goes to the engine behind those plays, which you build with Claude Code rather than by hand, so the sales team spends its hours in conversations instead of research and data entry. which scores news, hiring and leadership changes every night, into meetings with the people those signals point to.• Build account maps, contact scores and segments for campaigns and events, so every the AI agents the sales team uses every week (meeting prep, account research, post-call Salesforce updates, outreach drafts) and win adoption through short demos, an agent of the week, and fixing whatever made people stop using one.• Extend our GTM dashboard, a Next.js app on Vercel that reads Salesforce, with the funnel, BDR activity and account penetration views Business Development needs.• from the Brand Hub to the tooling that turns Product Marketing's material into decks, films and one-pagers a rep can send the same dayWhat success looks like in the first 12 months• After 3 months, two outbound plays are live end to end with reported conversion, Clay enrichment and the BD funnel view are yours, and you write our first touches yourself.• After 6 months, the BDRs run a play library without you, the whole sales team uses one of your agents every week, and qualified pipeline traces back to your plays.• After 12 months, you are the person everyone asks "how do we get into this account?", and the top-of-funnel engine runs every week without a push.Your Experience Must-have• 2 to 4 years in B2B go-to-market as a BDR, SDR, growth or sales ops hire at a startup or scale-up.• Meetings you booked yourself, so you know what a good first call feels like from the rep's side.• Automations in Clay, n8n, Zapier or Make that other people relied onSomething you shipped manufacturing, or engineering-software buyers.• A side project, newsletter, or LinkedIn presence that shows you can create demandWhy SPREAD?You sell AI for engineering to the biggest names in automotive and industry, with a product that customers run in production. jobs.occupation: PhD Positions in Agentic AI for Medical Image Analysis (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description: The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.The Division of Medical Image Computing (MIC) at the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) in Heidelberg, starting in January 2027, is offering PhD Positions in Agentic AI for Medical Image Analysis.The Division of Medical Image Computing (MIC) is recruiting PhD candidates to develop AI agents that interpret medical images, use analysis tools, evaluate intermediate results, and adapt their approach based on evidence and feedback.Candidates will join a collaborative research environment with clinical partners, extensive computing infrastructure, and connections to initiatives such as Helmholtz Imaging.Your TasksWe investigate how AI agents can combine medical images with clinical information, plan and execute analytical steps, learn from feedback, assess intermediate results, and respond appropriately to uncertainty or failure. Approaches may include reinforcement learning, multimodal learning, vision-language models, planning, tool-augmented language models, probabilistic modelling, and classical medical image analysis.Candidates may work primarily in one of several application areas:1. multimodal agents for prostate cancer diagnosis and treatment support;2. auditable analysis of longitudinal imaging for tumour-response assessment;3. federated multimodal agents connecting oral imaging with systemic health information; or4. or reinforcement learning for agents that navigate and integrate complex data across medical and other scientific domains.The individual PhD topic will be developed jointly based on the candidate’s interests, expertise, and the methodological questions arising across these applications.You will:- develop agents that combine medical images with clinical text and other information;- investigate reinforcement learning for planning, tool use, feedback integration, and iterative improvement;- apply agentic methods to segmentation, annotation, quantitative analysis, or scientific data exploration;- establish rigorous evaluation methods covering accuracy, robustness, generalisation, uncertainty calibration, failure detection, and appropriate abstention; and- collaborate with methodological and clinical researchers, publish your results, and contribute reusable software or benchmarks.Your ProfileYou should have:- A master’s degree in computer science, data science, mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related discipline- A strong foundation in machine learning and strong Python programming skills- Practical experience with a deep-learning framework such as PyTorch- Experience in at least one relevant area, such as reinforcement learning, computer vision, language models, multimodal learning, or medical-image analysis- An analytical and collaborative working style and good communication skills in EnglishPrevious experience with medical data is helpful but not required. We also welcome candidates with strong machine-learning fundamentals who want to develop expertise in agentic AI.What you can excpect:- Scientific freedom to develop your own methodological research question- Close supervision and exchange within a cohort of PhD researchers- Access to extensive GPU infrastructure, medical-imaging resources, and established research software- Collaboration with international machine-learning and clinical partners- Support for conference participation, open-source contributions, and professional development- Fully funded PhD submissionPlease submit:- your CV- academic transcripts- a brief research statement of no more than one page describing a question in agentic AI that interests you- your preferred application area, or a ranking of the available areas- your master’s thesis or another representative piece of scientific work- links to relevant publications, software, or code repositories, if available- Instead of a generic motivation letter, please use your research statement to explain which scientific question you would like to investigate, why it matters, and how you might approach itWe Offer- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level- Access to international research networks- Doctoral salary with the usual social benefits- 30 days of vacation per year- Flexible working hours- Possibility of part-time work- Family-friendly working environment- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket- Unleash your full potential: targeted training and mentoring through the DKFZ International PhD Program and DKFZ Career Service- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-beingAre you interested?Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!Contact:Constantin Ulrich HarsyPhone: +49 (0) 6221/42-3552Duration: The positions are initially limited to 3 years.Application environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day Join our dynamic team and immerse yourself in the exciting world of power systems and controls! You will build transient models for grid-connected converters and plants, including renewable energy systems, battery energy storage systems (BESS), HVDC, FACTS, and microgrids. Imagine defining and developing controller concepts that enhance the performance of converter-based assets, from inner controls to plant-level energy management. You will investigate the interactions among various systems, ensuring robust performance during normal operations and faults. Your expertise will drive innovation as you apply data analytics and AI/ML methods for predictive maintenance and load forecasting, all while mentoring the next generation of engineers in this critical field.How You’ll Make an Impact * Develop and validate transient models for converter-based grid assets, including renewables, BESS, HVDC, FACTS, industrial loads, data centers, and microgrids* Design, tune, and assess control strategies from converter inner controls to plant-level energy management and supervisory functions* Implement grid-following and grid-forming controls, including synchronization, voltage/frequency support, and fault ride-through capabilities* Analyze interactions between converter controls, plant controllers, and protection systems to optimize system performance and reliability* Perform dynamic, transient, and small-signal studies to evaluate system behavior and support controller tuning in weak and low-inertia grids* Apply advanced analytics and AI/ML techniques for forecasting, anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, while providing technical leadership and mentoringWhat You Bring* Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Power Systems, Control Engineering, or a related field with a focus on power systems and controls* Extensive professional experience in power-system modeling and studies, including development and validation of RMS and EMT models* Strong understanding of power-system dynamics, stability, fault response, and control interactions* Practical expertise in converter-based technologies and control architectures, including grid-following and grid-forming controls* Proficiency with industry-standard simulation tools (e.g., PowerFactory, PSCAD/EMTDC, MATLAB/Simulink) and programming in Python, MATLAB, or similar environments* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience in data analytics/AI/ML considered an advantage;
