jobs.occupation: Position for doctoral candidate (Dr. rer. nat. / PhD) in infectious disease immunology (m/f/x) fo... (Mikrobiologe/-biologin)
jobs.description: The Friedrich-Alexander-University (FAU) Erlangen-Nürnberg has been rated as one of the most innovative universities in Europe by Reuters or Times Higher Education. FAU and the University Hospital Erlangen (UKER) , which are located in the City of Erlangen in the North of Bavaria, Germany, carry out top-level research in immunology and have consistently ranked among the most successful German universities in attracting funding from the German Research Foundation ( Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft, DFG ) in the medical field of "Microbiology, Virology and Immunology". The FAU Profile Center Immunomedicine (FAU I-Med) unites more than 130 independent research groups from FAU, the UKER and the Max Planck Center for Physics and Medicine, which participate in numerous DFG-funded research  consortia and provide a strong scientific environment.One of these DFG-funded research consortia is the Research Training Group (RTG; Graduiertenkolleg, GRK) 2740 "ImmunoMicroTope" , which has been headed by Prof. Christian Bogdan since 2022. It is run by 13 outstanding research group leaders of the University Hospital Erlangen and the FAU and maintains close cooperations with two laboratories at the Universities of Regensburg and Cologne. The RTG 2740 focuses on the in situ analysis of the tissue microenvironment, the micromilieu factors and the metabolites that determine the immune response against bacterial, parasitic and fungal pathogens. The overarching goal of the consortium is the characterization of the complex "immunomicrotope" during infections (Bogdan et al., Trends in Parasitology 2024 10.1016/j.pt.2024.07.013 ( https://doi.org/10.1016/j.pt.2024.07.013 ) ).Your tasks:Within the RTG2740 "ImmunoMicroTope ", Prof. Christian Bogdan offers a PhD position in his dynamic research team in the project B2 "Role of sex and microbiota for the curative effect of L-arginine in chronic cutaneous leishmaniasis due to Leishmania mexicana infection".Type 2 nitric oxide synthase (NOS2) converts the amino acid L-arginine in the presence of molecular oxygen into nitric oxide (NO), which exerts antimicrobial and immunoregulatory functions. In previous studies, Prof. Bogdan's group showed that NOS2 is essential for the type 1 T helper cell-dependent control of intracellular pathogens, including the protozoan parasite Leishmania. In contrast, the expression of arginase 1 correlated with the progression of disease, pathogen persistence and immunopathology. Moreover, the group observed that the non-healing, chronic course of cutaneous leishmaniasis in Leishmania mexicana- infected female mice was prevented and reversed by external application of L-arginine. Currently, it is unclear, whether this effect is sex-dependent and whether it is influenced by the cutaneous and/or intestinal microbiota. The project aims to address these questions and to provide new mechanistic insights into the therapeutic effect of L-arginine with the ultimate goal to establish a new host-targeted treatment for chronic cutaneous leishmaniasis.For more information, please visit www.immunomicrotope.de ( https://www.immunomicrotope.de/beispiel-seite/project-areas/project-area-b-metabolism/b2-characterization-and-integrative-bioinformatic-modeling-of-metabolic-and-micro-milieu-factors-promoting-leishmania-survival/ ) and www.mikrobiologie.uk-erlangen.de/en/research/research-groups/research-group-of-prof-c-bogdan ( https://www.mikrobiologie.uk-erlangen.de/forschung/forschergruppen-arbeitsgruppen/ag-prof-c-bogdan/ ) /.( http://www.immunomicrotope.de/ )Essential experience/qualifications:- Master’s Degree in immunology or a related subject of life sciences (e.g., microbiology/microbiome research, parasitology, cell biology)- Excellent academic performance and high level of scientific interest- Practical and theoretical experience in the field of infectious disease immunology and microbiome analyses- Very good knowledge of bioinformatic programs and experience in bioinformatic analyses- Experience in mammalian cell culture, cell and molecular biology methods (e.g., flow cytometry, RNA/DNA isolation, quantitative PCR, ChIP, bulk and scRNAseq) and fluorescence (confocal) microscopy- Enthusiasm for experimental and bioinformatic work and for establishing new experimental methods and techniques- High responsibility, initiative, ambition, and motivation- Team spirit- Very good English language skills (C1 level or higher)- Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, Prism, Illustrator etc.Additionally beneficial are:- Experience with experimental in vivo mouse models- FELASA B certificate- Experience with imaging methods- Experience in the field of parasitology- Knowledge of the German languageComments:- The program starts on July 1 st 2027- The PhD position is available for initially 36 months- Pay grade is determined according to the qualifications and personal requirements as defined by TV-L E13- Please provide a single PDF file (last name_first name.pdf ) consisting of the following documents in English language:- Completed application form (RTG 2740 Application form_PhD; www.immunomicrotope.de ( https://www.immunomicrotope.de/how-to-apply/ ) )- Curriculum vitae- Letter of motivation- One-page summary each of the bachelor and master thesis- Copies of the university entrance exam, Bachelor exam and Master exam- Two letters of reference- Other credentials and information relevant to the RTG2740 programPlease note that applications that do not fulfill these formal requirements, will not be considered. There units communicated with each other and towards other satellites and ground stations by high frequency electrical or optical signals. Electromagnetic compatibility and immunity (EMC) of all these subsystems, equipment and payloads are essential for reliable satellite operations and final mission success. EMC is subsequently taken into account early on in the project and up to final acceptance by design rules, analysis, inspections and tests.In the frame of an internship of 3-6 months within an EMC laboratory, existing and partially automated test setups shall be upgraded and extended. Tasks will be performed in close collaboration with experienced engineers and will partially be utilized in running projects. The implementation shall be done in LabView, Visual Basic and MatLab.The department in which this internship will be allocated is responsible for the engineering and the verification of electrical systems of satellites for earth observation, navigation and science. The department supports all satellite projects in Friedrichshafen. This support includes the fields of RF communications, electromagnetic cleanliness, electrical power supply, harness design and data processing. It includes a broad band of services in the field of analysis and test.Your locationAt the Airbus site in Immenstaad on Lake Constance, you’ll work where the future of Connected Intelligence, Space, and Air Power takes shape. In an environment that offers vision, you will shape technological innovations across domains.Our location thrives on dialogue: on campus, you’ll connect with a unique network of experts in satellite technology, military aviation, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, as well as tomorrow's Combat Cloud and Ground Support. Our collaboration is equally dynamic—in agile teams, we tackle the most complex challenges, from AI-powered Earth observation to secure cloud architectures. German preferred. French appreciated.Tech You Bring- SIEM/SOAR platforms- Logging and monitoring tooling- OpenStack or comparable cloud infrastructure platforms- Kubernetes ecosystem- GitHub for configuration and issue management- Python, Bash, or comparable scripting languages- Cloud computing environments- Observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana- Threat intelligence platforms- Ticketing systems such as Jira and ServiceNowMeet the Team:You will join SAP Cloud Infrastructure Security Engineering, where we build the infrastructure behind SAP's enterprise, sovereign, and regulated cloud environments using technologies such as OpenStack, Kubernetes/Gardener, Ceph, and Prometheus.Our engineering culture is hands-on and collaborative. jobs.description: Job RequirementsDo you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?Then come and join our global team as Marketing Manager Magnetic Resonance (f/m/d) 1.5T / MAGNETOM Flow, to help shape the future of MR imaging.As a Marketing Manager (f/m/d), you will play a vital role in developing and implementing marketing strategies for our magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) solutions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including clinicians, engineers, communicators and external partners, to drive successful adoption of our products in the market.Choose the best place for your work - Within the scope of this position, it is possible, in consultation with your manager, to work mobile (within Germany) up to an average volume of 60% of the respective working hours.Even more flexibility? Mobile working from abroad is possible for up to 30 days a year under certain conditions and in selected countries.Your tasks and responsibilities:•As Marketing Manager you drive business growth and lead global outbound marketing activities for our MRI systems with 1.5T Tesla field strength and 70cm bore size, particularly MAGNETOM Flow. Platform (70cm).•You are responsible for driving the creation and implementation of marketing strategies for cross-portfolio initiatives centered around 'BioMatrix', our latest technology to adapt MRI examinations to patients' biovariability, as well as marketing activities around e.g. energy efficiency.•You enable outstanding customer experience within your area of responsibility, encompassing online product representation, development of marketing and sales support materials, as well as both virtual and in-person customer engagements.•You advise on all marketing-related topics for your segment and echo market needs into the organization, in close collaboration with solution owners.•You are responsible for defining and validating marketing claims in context of the release process for medical products (CE / FDA clearance).•You adopt and implement (digital) marketing guidelines, programs, and standards into the organizational unit.•You conduct market research and support in determining effective pricing, bundling and positioning structures. You contribute to budget planning and complete marketing-related reporting tasks.•You represent Siemens Healthineers at major industry congresses, visit reference sites, and attend key customer events.To find out more about the specific business, have a look at Magnetic Resonance Imaging.Your qualifications and experience:•You hold a university degree in Marketing or Business, Human Medicine, Medical Technology/Science, Engineering, Physics or an equivalent field.•You impress with many years of experience in the field of MR imaging, particularly in clinical context. Knowledge of MR image interpretation and protocol configuration is highly advantageous.•You already have extensive, long-term professional experience and further qualifications in this field, but no degree? Then we would also be delighted to receive your application.•You have comprehensive understanding of the MRI market, specifically of the 1.5T segment and understand what workflow efficiency and clinical excellence mean for our customers. Sales or business management experience is a plus.•You have a solid understanding of marketing principles and tools and are very confident in presenting in front of groups, as well as in utilizing presentation software such as PowerPoint.•In an optimal scenario, your profile is complemented by your expertise in launching and promoting medical products, as well as your know-how of defining and validating marketing claims in context of the Medical Device Regulation (MDR).Your attributes and skills:•You have very good English language skills and are confident within an international environment; German language skills are a plus.•You have a creative, innovation-oriented mindset coupled with strong communication skills, which help you to translate customer feedback into compelling, target group-oriented marketing materials.•You excel at storytelling and customer engagement. You communicate complex concepts clearly and build meaningful, trusted relationships.•You impress with your strong presentation and moderation skills, even in front of international audiences.•You are willing to travel approximately 20% of the time in order to represent Siemens Healthineers at customer events.Depending on the experience and qualifications background of the applicant, task enrichment into the area above the general pay scale is possible.Our global team:Siemens Healthineers is a leading global medical technology company. 74,000 dedicated colleagues in over 70 countries are driven to shape the future of healthcare. An estimated 5 million patients across the globe benefit every day from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine, as well as digital health and enterprise services.Our culture:Our culture embraces different perspectives, open debate, and the will to challenge convention. Change is a constant aspect of our work. We aspire to lead the change in our industry rather than just react to it. That's why we invite you to take on new challenges, test your ideas, and celebrate success.Check our Careers Site at https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careersAs an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.Wish to find out more before applying? Contact us: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com, if you wish to discuss any initial questions with our recruitment team. The contact person handling this job ad is Antonia Hanke.We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Click here to get started.To all recruitment agencies:Siemens Healthineers' recruitment is internally managed, with external support permitted only when a qualified supplier has established a formal contract with us. Unsolicited candidate submissions and referrals, absent a current supplier contract, do not establish consent and are ineligible for fees. We delete and destroy unsolicited information, thus, would recommend you refrain from any such practices. Your adherence to our policies is appreciated.

At the Max Planck Institute for Comparative Public Law and International Law, scholars pursue research relating to fundamental issues and current developments in the areas of public international law, European Union law, and the constitutional and administrative law of individual states, together with numerous visiting scholars from all over the world. In its fields, our library is the largest in Europe and one of the most comprehensive in the world.The newly established Max Planck Research Group “Constellations of Global (Dis)Ordering” (DISORDER), headed by Dr. Gordon Friedrichs at the Max Planck Institute for Comparative Public Law and International Law in Heidelberg, invites applications for twoResearch Fellow positions (Doctoral Researchers) (x/f/m)with a preferred starting date of 1 January 2027 (the positions are funded for three years)The Max Planck Research Group “Constellations of Global (Dis)Ordering” (DISORDER) investigates how global order is transformed as states - particularly great and middle powers - pursue competing visions of the principles, rules and institutions that structure international relations amid intensifying geopolitical rivalry. The group conceptualizes these processes as constellations of global (dis)ordering through which states seek to advance their visions of order by creating, reshaping, connecting, bypassing, or disengaging from international institutions, building new formal or ad hoc institutional arrangements, and strategically leveraging economic and technological interdependence. DISORDER examines how such constellations emerge across the fields of security, economy, and technology, and what forms of global order they produce, transform, or erode.Job descriptionThe successful candidates will develop independent doctoral dissertation projects within the framework of the Max Planck Research Group “Constellations of Global (Dis)Ordering” (DISORDER). Their research should contribute to the group’s broader inquiry into how states pursue competing visions of global order through international institutions and how these processes reshape global order across different issue areas.Possible orientations of the doctoral projects include:- an actor-centred perspective, examining how a particular great or middle power pursues its vision of global order across different issue areas institutional settings; or- a domain-centred perspective, comparing how different states interact with and reshape international institutions within a particular field, such as security, economy, or technology.Potential empirical cases may include, but are not limited to, the United States, China, Russia, India, Brazil, Japan, and other international actors such as the European Union.The doctoral researchers will:- develop and conduct an original PhD project that contributes to the conceptual and empirical agenda of the DISORDER research group;- conduct empirical research using qualitative methods such as process tracing, qualitative content and discourse analysis, and semi-structured interviews;- contribute to the comparative and collaborative research activities of the group;- participate in research group meetings, workshops, conferences, and other academic activities;- present research findings at international conferences and prepare publications for peer-reviewed academic outlets;- contribute to the organization of workshops, conferences, and other activities of the research group and the MPIL.Your profile- An excellent Master’s degree or equivalent in Political Science, with a specialization in International Relations or Foreign Policy Analysis- A strong research interest in global order, international institutions, and great- and middle-power politics, including their foreign policies- A substantive interest in one or more of the group’s empirical issue areas (security, economy, and technology)- A strong interest in qualitative research and familiarity with relevant research methods- Excellent written and spoken English- Additional language skills and country- or region-specific expertise relevant to the proposed doctoral project are considered assets- The ability to conduct independent research while contributing actively to a collaborative research environmentWe offer- An attractive and international work environment with an unparalleled research infrastructure and a good working atmosphere- A varied, responsible and team-orientated job- Remuneration in accordance with the guidelines of the MPG funding agreements (65 per cent of EG13, TVöD-Bund)- Access to our world-leading library and a multitude of databases- A workplace that is easy to reach by public transport and free employee parking spaces- A job ticket for public transport- Offers for work-life balance and four affiliated daycare centresApplicationThe Max Planck Society has set itself the goal of employing more severely disabled people. Applications from severely disabled persons are expressly encouraged. The Max Planck Society strives for gender equality and diversity. We welcome applications from all backgrounds. Furthermore, the Max Planck Society aims to increase the proportion of women in areas where they are underrepresented. Women are therefore strongly encouraged to apply.Interested candidates are invited to submit their complete application exclusively via the online application system (https://jobs.mpil.de/3vrp7) available on our website by 22 November 2026.Applications should include a CV, a cover letter of no more than two pages, copies of relevant degree certificates and transcripts of records, a one-page summary of the applicant’s Master’s thesis, a five-page PhD project proposal that clearly relates to the research agenda of the DISORDER group and indicates which of the thematic orientations outlined above the proposed project primarily addresses, and two letters of recommendationThe documents will be deleted after the application process. The interviews will take place in late November/early December in person at the Max Planck Institute for Comparative Public Law and International Law in Heidelberg. Application expenses cannot be covered.For questions regarding the positions, please contact Dr. Gordon Friedrichs at friedrichs@mpil.de (https://mailto:friedrichs@mpil.de) .

In Europe, Serco works through both established Serco operations and specialist local businesses, combining international capability with a strong understanding of national requirements and operating environments.European Homecare (EHC) in Germany and ORS in Switzerland are part of Serco and provide immigration and social care services in their respective markets. Each business has its own history, identity, workforce and stakeholder environment. Communications must therefore be locally relevant and sensitive to the nature of the services delivered, while supporting closer alignment with Serco’s standards, values, channels and wider European direction.The European Communications team supports operations across 10 countries, four sectors and five languages. It provides strategic advice, shared standards and specialist support across internal communications, media relations, issues and crisis communications, digital content and reputation. This role is the senior local communications lead for EHC in Germany and leads internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, while working as an integral member of the European Communications team.The postholder will have the autonomy to shape and deliver communications locally, working closely with local leaders and drawing on the expertise and support of the European Communications team. The role calls for sound judgement, curiosity and a practical approach to strengthening employee understanding, engagement and reputation as EHC and ORS continue their journey within Serco.Key purpose  - Lead communications for EHC in Germany across internal and external channels, ensuring communications are accurate, relevant and appropriate for a sensitive public-service environment.- Own internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, helping leaders keep employees informed, engaged and connected to local priorities and Serco’s wider direction.- Act as a trusted communications adviser to the EHC and ORS leadership teams, providing clear, practical and well-judged counsel, including in complex, sensitive or fast-moving situations.- Build strong networks across the local businesses and Serco Europe, connecting people, expertise and information so communications are coordinated and effective.- Support the continued integration of EHC and ORS within Serco, respecting their local identities while embedding Serco’s communications standards, governance, channels and values.Structure and reporting relationship The role reports to the Customer Relations (CR) & Operations Director Switzerland. The postholder is also a core member of the European Communications team and works closely with the Director of Communications, Marketing and Public Affairs Europe and European Communications colleagues on priorities, standards, governance and delivery. The role operates with a high degree of independence and works closely with EHC leadership in Germany and ORS leadership in Switzerland.  Internal Communications- Own and deliver the internal communications plans for EHC in Germany and ORS in Switzerland, including print and digital newsletters, leadership updates, employee announcements, change communications and internal campaigns, working closely with local leaders and the European Communications team.- Draft and distribute newsletters; act as an internal correspondent to identify and write impactful stories.- Lead employee engagement initiatives aligned with Serco’s values and business priorities.- Develop and maintain content for internal platforms.  External Communications- Lead day-to-day media relations in Germany and preferably Switzerland, including media monitoring, handling enquiries, preparing spokespeople and coordinating responses with European Communications colleagues when required.- Lead local issues management and crisis communications preparedness, providing calm, practical and well-judged advice to leaders in sensitive or difficult situations.- Produce clear written and visual content for external channels, including social media, in line with European Communications standards and priorities.- Manage the German-speaking  website of Immigration Europe and related external digital content for Germany and Switzerland, in line with European Communications standards and approvals.Integration Communications- Contribute to integration plans following recent acquisitions, ensuring employees and stakeholders are informed and engaged.- Apply strong change communications judgement, identifying how different audiences may respond to change and adapting messages, channels and engagement approaches to their needs and sensitivities.Social Media & Content Creation- Collaborate with the European communications team to source, create, and promote content that showcases services, people, and impact.Stakeholder Engagement- Build and sustain trusted relationships across operations, HR, corporate functions and leadership teams, creating effective networks within EHC in Germany, ORS in Switzerland and the wider European business.- Represent the European Communications function locally. Act as a trusted communications adviser to EHC leaders in Germany across the full communications remit and to ORS leaders in Switzerland on internal communications, constructively challenging proposed approaches where reputational, employee or stakeholder considerations require it.- For German-speaking market, develop and maintain strong working relationships with relevant media, partners, public authorities and other external stakeholders, supported by accurate and well-maintained contact information and external specialist partners.Essential technical and professional skills, knowledge, and qualifications - Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.- At least seven years’ relevant communications experience, including substantial responsibility for advising senior leaders, managing communications independently and delivering through influence in a complex, matrixed organisation.- Proven experience across internal communications, external communications, media relations, change communications and employee engagement.- Strong change management and change communications acumen, with the ability to understand audience sensitivities, anticipate resistance and translate complex change into clear, relevant communications.- Excellent planning and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise competing demands across two businesses and maintain consistent delivery.- Demonstrable experience of working with journalists, handling media enquiries and advising spokespeople, with the judgement to manage sensitive or high-pressure situations.- Strong digital communications capability, including confident use of Microsoft 365, SharePoint and content management tools.- Ability to brief and manage specialist creative support when needed, ensuring outputs meet communications objectives and brand standards.- Able to navigate a large, matrixed company while remaining pragmatic, visible and hands-on within smaller subsidiaries. Imagine driving initiatives that foster a culture of safe behavior and helping us climb the safety culture ladder. You will lead training initiatives within the EQS team, ensuring continuous improvement under our Zero Harm framework and integrated management systems, particularly focusing on ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards. Your analytical skills will shine as you track incident statistics and support root cause analyses, all while promoting regulatory compliance and closing any gaps.How You’ll Make an Impact * Drive initiatives to enhance a culture of safety within the organization* Lead and support necessary EHS training initiatives to promote awareness and compliance* Analyze EHS data and report incident statistics to identify trends and areas for improvement* Provide guidance on environmental, health, and safety issues, ensuring regulatory compliance* Facilitate regular meetings within the EQS community to promote information exchange and updates* Support root cause analysis of EHS events and track identified actions for continuous improvementWhat You Bring* A Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as engineering, industrial engineering, or environmental engineering* Several years of EHS experience in manufacturing or a related industry, ideally within Grid Technologies* Strong communication skills, akin to those of an influencer or salesperson, to effectively promote safety culture* Training as a specialist in occupational safety is a significant advantage* Experience in high-risk activities such as cranes & lifting, machine guarding, and energy isolation* Proficiency in EHS management systems (ISO 14001; ISO 45001) and skills in auditing and root cause investigation* Good written and spoken German and English skills, with a willingness to travel occasionallyAbout the TeamOur Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. Tätigkeitsbereich: IT/TelekommunikationFachabteilung: Payment-related ProductsGesellschaft: Mercedes pay GmbHStandort: BerlinStartdatum: 01.06.2026Veröffentlichungsdatum: 01.06.2026Stellennummer: MER00044HAArbeitszeit: Full timeAufgabenWHAT WE DOPicture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.ABOUT MERCEDES PAYMercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORKWe are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCEYou assess current systems, infrastructure, and business processes to identify improvement opportunities and ensure compatibility with new solutions- You collect and analyze stakeholder requirements to define solution scope and objectives- You architect the Mercedes Pay Digital Voucher Solution, detailing structure, components, interfaces, and data flows, and select suitable technologies, platforms, and tools- You create proof-of-concept projects to validate solutions and demonstrate feasibility- You work with an experienced team of Solution Architects as well as the company's Enterprise, Cloud and Security Architects to derive right-fit solutions- You facilitate the collaboration with external development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural guidelines and best practices- You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex technical details into accessible language- You document solutions and disseminate best practices among team membersQualifikationenWHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE- You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field- You have 5+ years of experience as a Solution Architect, with a strong focus on software product development- You have practical experience in at least one of the following domains: regulatory environments, agentic commerce, loyalty programs, vouchers, digital marketing, or payments (including PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, or AML/KYC)- You are proficient in microservices, event-driven architectures, cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, CI/CD), Auth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) protocols, alongside practices like Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and DevOps- You have hands-on experience with tools such as Jira, GitHub, and Datadog- You have a proven track record of implementing cutting-edge technologies within a corporate environment- You possess strong teamwork and good communication skills, with the ability to maintain composure under pressure- You are fluent in English; German language skills are a strong plusOUR OFFER TO YOU·       Modern and dynamic work environment·       Flexible and mobile working·       Attractive fitness offer·       Numerous employee discounts·       Excellent infrastructureThis is a full-time job (also suitable for part-time). We particularly welcome applications from disabled persons. Please apply online via www.group.mercedes-benz.com/careers (ID:MER0003ZHV). jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day The growing number of decentralized renewables is making it much more difficult to ensure reliable and stable grid operation. Flexible AC Transmission Systems (FACTS) are the perfect solution for increasing the reliability of AC grids, ensuring stability, and boosting transmission efficiency. Siemens Energy supports customers around the world with innovative FACTS to help them master the challenges of energy transitions. But honestly, we can’t do it alone! Transforming the entire energy system requires you to play a part.How You’ll Make an Impact * You will develop FACTS turnkey projects from the first idea in customers mind till successful signature. These projects can be several hundred millions worth.* Your prime task will be technical sales for the global market for STATCOM and E-STATCOM with supercapacitors, with special focus on eSTATCOM in the USA.* You will carry out pre-qualifications and provide budget offers.* You will prepare the sales strategy for projects including pricing.* You will also be in the lead to negotiating and successfully close the contracts together with our commercial experts.* Close cooperation with associated engineering, tender and project execution departments is the key to developing a tailored concept to the customers’ requirements as the basis for a successful project development.* During the whole time, you will build up and maintain relationships by making frequent visits to our worldwide customers' decision makers. You will also cooperate with our regional organization providing local support and customer intimacy.* As a technical sales expert, you will also consistently monitor market development in the assigned sales area and maintain the project lists on an ongoing basis.What You Bring* Master's degree in electrical engineering or industrial engineering, preferably with a focus on high-voltage engineering.* Long term sales experience in electrical energy transmission turnkey solution business.* Technical knowledge in the field of FACTS, especially power electronics based STATCOMS will be an absolute plus. * High‑voltage, control & protection or system‑design engineering experience, hands‑on control & protection commissioning will be an asset.* Strong know‑how in supercapacitors will be a major advantage in this role.* Willingness for international travel and visits to customers plant sites for up to 20%.* Experience in leading teams across country borders.* Comfortable in presenting in front of customers and internal top management. * Proficient in English. Additional German skills are a strong upside.  About the TeamOur Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  * We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.#LI-AB3https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

jobs.occupation: Sales Manager (f/m/d) Test & Validation - DACH (Ingenieur/in - Gebäudetechnik)
jobs.description: Shape the Future of Engineering Test & ValidationWe are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation - helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.Our Testing business sits at the heart of this transformation. As products become more software-defined, connected, electrified, and complex, manufacturers need to bring together physical testing, data acquisition, simulation, analysis, and engineering software into a connected validation process.This creates a significant growth opportunity - and we are looking for an exceptional commercial leader to lead it across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH).The OpportunityAs Test Country Lead (w/m/d) DACH, you will own the commercial success and growth of the Siemens Test business across the region.You will lead the Sales and PreSales organization while remaining highly visible in the market and directly engaged with strategic customers. This is a player-coach leadership role: you will build and develop a high-performing organization while personally shaping major opportunities, executive relationships, and strategic accounts.You will spend at least 50% of your time with strategic customers and in the market, ensuring that you remain close to customer priorities, technology trends, competitive dynamics, and the opportunities shaping the future of engineering test and validation.This is an opportunity to build and grow a significant business in one of the world's most important engineering markets, supported by Siemens' global technology portfolio, resources, and customer relationships.What you will ownLead the DACH Test Business- Own the overall commercial performance of the Test business across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.- Drive revenue, growth, profitability, and market-share objectives across hardware, software, maintenance, and customer & engineering services.- Define and execute the regional business strategy and annual operating plan.- Identify new growth opportunities, markets, customers, and routes to market.- Establish clear commercial priorities, KPIs, and accountability across the organization.Lead from the Market- Personally engage with strategic customers and executive stakeholders, building trusted relationships at C-level and senior engineering levels.- Lead major strategic sales pursuits and complex, multi-year opportunities.- Develop compelling value propositions and quantified business cases that connect technology investment to measurable customer outcomes.- Understand customer engineering and validation challenges and translate them into differentiated Siemens solutions.- Maintain a strong understanding of market trends, competitor strategies, technology shifts, and emerging customer requirements.- Represent Siemens Test at customer events, industry conferences, and executive forums.Build a High-Performing Sales Organization- Lead, coach, and develop the DACH Sales and PreSales organization.- Recruit and retain exceptional commercial and technical sales talent.- Create a culture of accountability, customer obsession, collaboration, and continuous improvement.- Align individual strengths and expertise with strategic market opportunities.- Establish clear development and succession plans for key roles.- Raise the overall standard of consultative, value-based, and solution-oriented selling.Win in a Competitive Market- Develop differentiated strategies for strategic accounts and competitive opportunities.- Build strong account and territory plans that increase market penetration and customer value.- Lead competitive positioning across the Test & Validation landscape.- Govern Proof-of-Concept engagements with clear success criteria, commercial objectives, and transition plans.- Develop and manage a high-performing partner ecosystem to extend market reach and accelerate growth.Connect Customers with Siemens Technology- Work closely with global Product Management, Industry, Engineering, and Services teams to bring the right solutions to customers.- Ensure that customer feedback and market intelligence directly influence regional and global strategy.- Drive adoption of the broader Siemens portfolio by connecting test, measurement, simulation, engineering software, and services into compelling customer solutions.- Ensure operational excellence through accurate forecasting, disciplined opportunity management, reliable demonstrations, and measurable sales performance.What You BringWe are looking for an accomplished Sales Director, Business Leader, or Commercial Leader who combines strong sales leadership with a deep understanding of engineering-driven technology markets, especially in test & validation.- A successful track record in B2B sales leadership within engineering software, test & measurement, validation, simulation, industrial technology, or a closely related field- Experience leading Sales and PreSales organizations with direct responsibility for regional business performance.- A proven record of winning complex, high-value opportunities involving multiple technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders.- Strong experience developing strategic accounts and building long-term relationships with senior engineering and executive decision-makers.- Experience selling solutions such as test & measurement, data acquisition, test automation, validation, simulation, NVH, HIL/XIL, engineering software, or related technologies is highly valuable.- Strong commercial judgment and demonstrated success in negotiations and complex deal structures.- The ability to translate sophisticated technology into clear customer value and compelling business outcomes.- Experience building, coaching, and motivating high-performing sales organizations.- A strong external network and understanding of the DACH engineering and manufacturing ecosystem.- Experience working with strategic partners and developing indirect routes to market.- Strong understanding of industries such as Automotive & Transportation, Aerospace & Defense, Electronics & Semiconductors, Energy, and Industrial Machinery.- Excellent executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and storytelling skills.- Willingness to travel regularly across the DACH region and internationally.- Highly proficient spoken and written German and English.Why UsWe are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across many countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!Our Benefits & RewardsThe primary locations for this opportunity are Austria, Germany, and Switzerland. The applicable salary ranges for these locations are:Austria: €162,200 – €308,300Germany: €145,500 – €291,000Switzerland: CHF 249,900 – CHF 437,200This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation with 50% of this being comprised of an annual incentive target (100% achievement). The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/ (https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/)This position may also be posted in additional locations beyond those specified above. For such locations, the applicable salary ranges and benefits will be disclosed by the Talent Acquisition Partner at the time of initial contact, in accordance with local legal requirements.Equal OpportunitiesWe value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. jobs.description: html Expert R&D Automation and Data Management (m/f/d)Become part of a vital chain and contribute to our common goal of making people’s lives better. Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing medicines sourced from human plasma and human cell lines. We are a privately-owned company, where the warmth of family meets the scale of a global organisation.Octapharma Biopharmaceuticals GmbH with more than 200 employees is a subsidiary of the Octapharma group founded in 1997 and successfully expanding. Our core business is the development of recombinant proteins produced in human cell lines for therapeutic use in humans. We strive for effective treatments with an improved tolerability and convenience for our patients.Join us in shaping our vision to provide new health solutions advancing human life.We are looking for anExpert R&D Automation and Data Management (m/f/d)to join the Automation and Data Management unit within the Research and Development Department at Octapharma Biopharmaceuticals GmbH.The Automation and Data Management unit is responsible for the development, evaluation and long-term maintenance of automation- and data-driven solutions across R&D. The unit supports scientific projects by combining laboratory automation, data management, bioinformatics and scientific computing, and is involved in the work of multiple research units and virtually all projects within the department.The successful candidate will take on a challenging and versatile role with a strong focus on scientific computing, molecular modelling and high-performance computing (HPC). jobs.employer_name: Technische Universität München (TUM),  Forschungs-Neutronenquelle Heinz Maier-Leibnitz ...
jobs.description: Technical University Munich operates the high flux Neutron Source Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) located at the scientific campus in Garching, Germany. The neutron source itself, its research instruments as well as the irradiation facilities provide unique possibilities for the scientific and industrial use of neutron beams.TOFTOF is a neutron time-of-flight chopper spectrometer to study dynamic processes in hard and soft condensed matter. The main areas of application are from materials science, soft matter, biological or magnetic systems. After years of successful operation, the instrument will receive a significant technical upgrade in the coming years.For the further development and the operation of the instrument TOFTOF we invite applications for a full-time (40 h/week) scientist position (m/f/d) asInstrument Scientist Toftof (m/f/d) You will be responsible for the scientific oversight of the technical upgrade of the instrument TOFTOF and attend to its technical realisation.Your tasks include:Scientific lead of TOFTOF’s further developments, i.e. of the neutron transport and chopper system. Conceptual design and future development of the secondary spectrometer, including the neutron detectors. Demonstration of its performance for the intended scientific applications.Project lead for the technical realisation of the upgrade work packages at TOFTOFExperimental tests of instrument critical components to validate performanceMethod development in the area of neutron spectroscopyOperation of the instrument and scientific and technical support in user operationPursuit of own scientific projects using neutron spectroscopy methodsYour responsibility is focused on the instrument TOFTOF. In future, your tasks might include further instrumentation projects.PhD in physics, chemistry, materials science, or a related field.Strong background in neutron spectroscopy and hands-on experience with experimental techniques and instrumentation. Experience with polarized neutrons are an asset.Demonstrated ability to conduct instrumentation projects and operate complex scientific setups.Knowledge of scientific programming and data analysis (e.g. Python, C++, MATLAB) is required, experience with ray tracing simulation packages, e.g. McStas, are beneficial.Self-motivated and independent working style combined with the ability to work in an international and interdisciplinary team.Demonstrated ability to conduct independent scientific research and motivation to develop an own scientific research profilePersuasive communication skills and ability to work in a team in an international environment are mandatory. Good oral and written English skills are required, German language skills are an asset.For further information about the position, please contact Wiebke Lohstroh, E-Mail: wiebke.lohstroh@frm2.tum.deThe high safety standard of our facility requires the reliability of the employees according to German nuclear law. Appropriate reliability checks have to be performed for all employees.We offer flexible working hours, 30 days' vacation per year and a company pension plan (VBL). As an employee of FRM II, you can benefit from many other TUM offers, such asTUM's health offersUniversity sportsTUM's internal continuing education and training opportunitiesTUM childcare (subject to availability)Very good accessibility by public transportThe position is remunerated according to TV-L and limited to 3 years. The position is suitable for severely disabled people. Severely disabled applicants will be given preference if they otherwise have essentially the same suitability, qualifications and professional performance. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women. Applications from women are therefore expressly welcomed.

IntroductionATworld, operated by Simplify Places GmbH, is redefining the way we work and connect.We offer a flexible, connected, and ownable 'fourth space' - a dynamic ecosystem where individuals and companies can access resources, services, and communities anytime, anywhere.Supported today by hotels and offices owned by Aroundtown, ATworld is rapidly expanding across Europe and partnering with external locations such as hotels, cafés, and coworking spaces. The CompanyUndagrid is part of the EnOcean group and delivers end-to-end asset tracking and IoT solutions that give customers in aviation, logistics and industry full visibility of their assets, equipment and operations. The Undagrid platform combines self-powered and battery-driven sensor devices with BLE-based indoor positioning, GPS/GNSS outdoor tracking and cellular IoT connectivity, and turns the resulting data into dashboards, analytics and reports that customers rely on every day. We are the leader in sensing and control products for IoT infrastructures and combine it with energy harvesting technologies for maintenance-free solutions that gain their energy from the environment enabling a sustainable world.The Role & YouYou are the technical face of our asset tracking platform towards our worldwide customer base. Working side by side with Sales, Product Management and Engineering, you guide customers from the first platform demonstration through deployment, training and day-to-day operations, and make sure they get measurable value out of our solutions. As an integral part of a global Customer Success team, you combine hands-on platform expertise with a strong feel for our customers’ business processes, and you turn what you learn in the field into better products.This position can be based in either Munich (Germany) , Copenhagen (Denmark) or Utrecht (the Netherlands) . We are recruiting for one role and will hire one candidate . The employment contract will be concluded with the local EnOcean entity at the selected location. Please apply only once and indicate your preferred location.#LI-HybridWhat you’ll be doing• Act as the primary technical counterpart in customer meetings alongside Sales and PM, and build strong relationships with technical, operational and management stakeholders on the customer side• Deliver compelling platform demonstrations and showcase advanced functionality in a way that creates confidence and excitement with customers• Support solution design and deployment planning for new customer projects, and support our customers worldwide in deploying EnOcean and Undagrid solutions in their network and IT infrastructure• Configure and administer the platform independently, including tenant creation, user management, dashboard setup, reporting and minor customizations to meet customer requirements• Deliver technical and operational training for customer teams, from end users to administrators and IT stakeholders• Travel to customer sites when needed to support deployments, training, workshops, troubleshooting and business reviews• Validate our solutions in the field and at customer sites, identify technical problems and drive them to resolution• Collect customer requirements and translate them into actionable improvements and product feedback, working closely with our sales, product marketing, product management and engineering teamsWhat we’re looking for• BSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or a relevant field, combined with 5–10 years of experience in the asset tracking, IoT, RTLS, telematics, or related industries• Solid understanding of both indoor and outdoor tracking technologies: BLE-based indoor positioning and proximity tracking, GPS/GNSS-based outdoor tracking, as well as cellular IoT, telematics and fleet tracking concepts• Experience working with asset tracking platforms, dashboards, analytics and customer reporting, as well as with tools such as Grafana, git and Jira• Experience in installing and configuring network equipment, ideally in the field of aviation or logistics• Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving skills across hardware, connectivity and software domains• Good understanding of business processes and operational use cases, enabling you to discuss both technical capabilities and business value with customers• Ability to communicate effectively with everyone from operational users and IT departments to senior management, paired with a hands-on, problem-solving attitude in direct customer contact• Willingness to travel worldwide and to adjust your working schedule to support customers in different time zones• Fluent English is a must, additional language skills are a plusWhat we offer and what you can expect• Flexible working hours, well balanced work-life ratio• Work in an international and interdisciplinary team with great spirit• Freedom to express and develop yourself• Be part of a company that develops innovative technology for a greener world

jobs.occupation: SoftwareOne Deutschland GmbH: Regional Services Leader (gn) DACH (IT-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Job FunctionServicesWarum SoftwareOne?SoftwareOne ist ein globaler Anbieter und Distributor von Software- und Cloud-Lösungen. Rund 12.000 Menschen in mehr als 70 Ländern sind Teil von SoftwareOne. Was uns wirklich ausmacht, sind jedoch unsere Mitarbeitenden: neugierige Köpfe, unterschiedliche Perspektiven und talentierte Teams, die gemeinsam Lösungen entwickeln und etwas bewegen. Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, dich weiterzuentwickeln, Neues zu entdecken und deinen eigenen Karriereweg zu gestalten. Gleichzeitig trägst du dazu bei, die technologische Zukunft voranzutreiben.Die Rolle- Do you want to lead a high-impact Services organization that connects local execution with global collaboration and directly influences our customers’ experience?  - Are you ready to take ownership of SoftwareOne’s Services delivery across DACH and shape strategic customer outcomes?  Practical information  Location: Germany, Switzerland or Austria | Reports to: Regional President DACH | Team: Regional Services Delivery | Work arrangement: Hybrid | Language requirements: Fluent/Professional level English and German, written and verbal. Visa Requirements: Valid visa for DACH region.     Leading a Services organisation of around 650 people and a substantial Services P&L across DACH, you will align regional execution with the company operating model, strengthen collaboration between Services and Sales, and build the leadership capability needed to scale high-quality delivery across the region. This leadership role combines business ownership, service delivery excellence, operational performance, and strategic growth across the DACH region. Key responsibilities include:- Leading the successful delivery of Professional, Managed, and Support Services across DACH, ensuring consistent execution, customer satisfaction, and alignment with global governance standards.- Optimising regional, remote, and partner delivery capabilities to balance customer outcomes, scalability, operational efficiency, and profitable growth.- Driving customer adoption, transformation outcomes, and long-term value realisation while ensuring services deliver measurable business impact.- Owning regional Services performance, including P&L, forecasting, revenue recognition, delivery costs, investments, operational KPIs, and financial targets.- Partnering with Sales, Marketing, Alliances, vendors, and executive customer stakeholders to grow the Services business and drive successful delivery of strategic engagements.- Leading proactive risk, escalation, SLA, and governance management to protect customer satisfaction, business performance, and commercial outcomes.- Driving innovation, automation, standardisation, and continuous improvement to enhance delivery quality, productivity, and scalability.- Aligning regional execution with portfolio strategy, strategic growth priorities, and the Centres of Excellence framework.- Building and developing high-performing leadership teams, strengthening succession, talent development, collaboration, and knowledge sharing.- Acting as a visible executive leader and role model, fostering a culture of accountability, customer focus, performance, and continuous improvement.Kenntnisse und FähigkeitenWe are looking for a senior services leader with the commercial depth, delivery discipline, and executive presence to scale a complex regional Services business. You bring: - Demonstrated experience leading large-scale Professional, Managed, and Support Services organisations, with accountability for business performance, operational excellence, and sustainable growth.- A strong commercial mindset, with the ability to drive revenue, profitability, customer satisfaction, and strategic business outcomes in a complex services environment.- Proven success building, developing, and inspiring high-performing leadership teams across multiple countries, locations, and cultures.- The ability to influence and align senior stakeholders across Sales, Delivery, Country Leadership, strategic partners, and vendors to achieve shared objectives and accelerate business success.- Deep expertise in scaling and optimising service delivery organisations, leveraging market insights, modern delivery practices, and strong Go-to-Market collaboration to drive customer value and business growth. Das haben wir zu bietenOur employees are our most valuable asset, and because of that we work actively on creating an environment where you can feel at home and thrive: - Varying tasks with scope for creativity and development in an internationally connected environment - Flexible working with the option to work from home - Time for new perspectives: the option of a sabbatical or workation - Embracing diversity through equal opportunities, our DEIB strategy, and the Women in Tech initiative - Structured onboarding with a personal buddy from day one and tailored learning and development opportunities You can find all country-specific benefits here:  - Benefits Deutschland - Benefits Schweiz - Benefits Österreich Schlagworte: Services, Englisch, Softwareentwicklung, servicemanagement, Servicemanagement, service-management, Service-management, Softwareentwickler, webservice, Webservice, AI, Support, support, Webentwickler, Systemingenieur, KI, Go, Anwendungsentwicklung, Anwendungsentwickler, softwaredevelopment, EmpfehlungsbundQuelle/Bewerbung via: https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/308160/regional-services-leader-gn-dach (https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/308160/regional-services-leader-gn-dach#apply_form)Kurzinfo zum UnternehmenSoftwareOne ist ein führender Anbieter von Software- und Cloud-Lösungen. Unser Ziel ist es, die Art und Weise, wie Unternehmen ihre Cloud planen, betreiben oder darüber beschaffen, neu zu definieren. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden bei der Migration sowie Modernisierung ihrer Workloads und Anwendungen und stehen ihnen bei der Optimierung der daraus resultierenden Software- und Cloud-Änderungen beratend zur Seite. Somit erschließen wir den gesamten Mehrwert der Cloud-Technologien für unsere Kunden.Homeoffice:Umfang: Maximal 100%

jobs.occupation: Senior Electronics PCB & ECAD Design Engineer - RF & Mixed Signal (m/f/d) (Forschungs- und Entwicklungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description: RoleHive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. Our RF communication systems are Made in Germany, deployed on active frontlines, and targeting a highly valued tactical communication market with zero sovereign alternatives today.As our Senior Electronics Hardware Engineer, you own our electronic designs end to end: from requirements through schematic capture, PCB layout, and manufacturing release to bring-up and debugging. You take a hardware requirement and independently turn it into a robust, manufacturable PCB assembly, spot problems early, and keep projects moving without waiting for direction. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. Most importantly, you enjoy designing hardware yourself and seeing it ship. You report into our CTO organization.Bring-up, rework, and close work with mechanical, firmware, and production happen hands-on in our Munich office, so we expect you on site most days of the week.ResponsibilitiesSchematic & PCB Design- Own electronic hardware designs from requirements to manufacturing release, including schematics and design reviews- Select components based on performance, availability, lifecycle, cost, and manufacturability- Place and route multilayer boards, and define stack-ups, design rules, controlled-impedance requirements, and layout constraints- Review designs for manufacturability, reliability, EMC, signal and power integrity, and thermal behavior where relevant- Design with certification in mind: support EMC and radio (CE/RED) pre-compliance and certification testing with external labs, and feed the findings back into the designECAD Libraries & Engineering Data- Create and maintain schematic symbols, footprints, padstacks, and ECAD libraries- Define and maintain electrical, physical, and manufacturing design rule sets- Keep engineering data clean: design documentation, revision history, and versioning that let anyone pick up a design later and improve it- Improve engineering workflows and automate repetitive tasks where it pays offManufacturing & Supply- Generate, review, and release manufacturing outputs and technical documentation- Work directly with PCB fabrication and PCBA assembly partners on stack-ups, fabrication constraints, assembly guidelines, and production requirements- Review BOMs and qualify alternative components based on availability, lifecycle, and technical requirements, together with Operations- Make sure designs scale from prototype runs to serial production volumesBring-up, Test & Integration- Bring up, debug, and validate boards, including burn-in testing, soldering, and rework- Work closely with mechanical and embedded firmware engineers through design, integration, and bring-up- Reproduce and qualify hardware issues from production and the field so they get fixed at the root cause- Handle sensitive and export-controlled design data in line with our dual-use export control requirementsRequirementsYou do not need to tick every box or master every topic from day one. If the core is there and you have the drive to grow into the rest, we want to hear from you.Must Have- 5+ years of professional experience in electronic hardware and PCB development- Degree in electrical engineering, electronics, or a comparable technical foundation- A track record of independently taking PCBs from schematic to manufacturing release: boards you designed that went into production- Strong schematic design and component selection skills, working confidently from datasheets- Strong PCB layout skills on multilayer and high-density boards, including blind and buried vias, built on a solid understanding of grounding, power distribution, differential interfaces, controlled impedance, and high-speed design- Practical understanding of PCB fabrication and PCBA assembly, including direct work with manufacturers on stack-ups, fabrication rules, assembly requirements, and production issues- Hands-on lab skills: board bring-up, debugging, lab equipment, soldering, and rework- Strong experience in at least one professional ECAD environment, such as Cadence OrCAD/Allegro, Siemens Xpedition, or comparable. - Ownership mindset: you drive designs forward without continuous supervision, and an undocumented design change is a problem for you, not a shortcut- Fluent English (German is a plus)- Willingness to undergo security vetting where projects require it- Based in Munich or willing to relocateNice to Have- Cadence OrCAD/Allegro, which our existing products are built on- Experience with BOM management or component lifecycle tools- RF and wireless electronics or communication systems, the core of what we build- Ethernet and high-speed digital interfaces, power electronics, or embedded systems- EMC/EMI-conscious design and experience taking products through EMC and radio certification (CE/RED)- Electronics for robotics, UAVs, or other ruggedized systems, ideally in defense, aerospace, or another regulated environment- Connector selection, wiring harness, and pinout definition- Scripting or engineering automationAbout usWe work in deep-tech and dual-use technology, an industry where women and other underrepresented groups have historically had limited access. We encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box below.Why Hive- Build sovereign technology that matters. We build RF communication and orchestration systems for unmanned platforms across air, land, sea, and space, at a moment when European technological sovereignty is a real strategic question, not an abstract one.- Real ownership, real deployment. Our products are already in serial production and in the field. What you build ships, and you see the result.- Small team, direct access. Around 30 people. You'll work directly with founders and not through multiple layers of management.- You shape the foundations. We're still building the structures, career paths, controlling, compliance, that let a fast-growing company scale well. You'll help decide what they look like.- Modern Munich office, with the tools and equipment to do your best work.What You Get- Compensation. We benchmark salaries to stay competitive for the market and the role, not just what an early-stage budget can spare.- Equity. You participate in Hive through equity/VSOP, a genuine stake in what we build, not just a paycheck.- A role you shape, not one you're handed. We're too early for fixed job descriptions or a career ladder. What you own grows as you take on more, not by climbing steps someone else defined.- No bureaucracy. Small, flat team. Decisions happen in a conversation, not a sign-off chain.Compensation and equity terms vary by role and level.Hive Robotics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or marital status. Please don't include data on ethnic origin, political views, religious beliefs, union membership, health, or sexual orientation in your application.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Leiterplatten-Designsysteme (PCB-Design)

About UsWe make the business of games work for the people who make them.rcp is an independent production house from Munich, around since 2005. Part dealmaker, part production house, part backer. We sit on the business side of the table for a family of 15 partner studios across Europe, South America and South Asia, so they can spend their time making games. When our studios win, we win.What that looks like day to day:• We sell our studios’ games and teams to publishers and platforms• We structure deals, funding and investment• We broker co-development, porting and work-for-hire• We build serious games for finance, health and defenseMore than 300 games and interactive projects so far, from Songs of Silence and Bus Simulator to Angry Birds Epic and Ostwind.Where we’re going We’re building something the games industry doesn’t have yet: a 'United Artists' for game makers. Studios that own their work, share the upside and back each other.rcp has a strong reputation and a weak brand. For you, that’s room: you get to put your own stamp on it.How we work• Roles, not positions. Inspired by holacracy. One person often holds several roles, and roles change as the work changes• Strikeforces. Small cross-functional teams around a partner studio or a mission, with clear accountability for each role• Radical candor. We care personally and challenge directly. You get honest feedback, and we expect you to give it, including to the CEO• AI-second, human-first. Coordination and admin go to AI, so people spend their time on judgment, relationships and dealsYour role: Remote (Europe or North America, on European hours) or Munich · Full-time · Exclusive freelance start possible, then permanentThe short version We need a dealmaker who opens doors at the top table and brings the close home. You take over the relationships our CEO built over 20 years, and you build your own. No team to manage. A direct line to the CEO.Why this role exists Our CEO built rcp’s top relationships over 20 years. We want someone to take them over, grow them, and become the face of rcp at the top table.You open doors at Director and VP level. You bring opportunities that hold up. You bring the close home without giving terms away early. A door-opener with soft leads doesn’t help us. A door-opener who closes does.This is a director-level role as an individual contributor. You don’t manage a team. You work directly with our CEO, our Biz team and the studio heads across the rcp family.Your responsibilities will include:• Open doors at the right level: Director and VP+ at large publishers and platforms, CEO level at smaller publishers, plus project financiers, games investors and fast-growing self-publishing developers• Pitch and sell projects from the rcp family: original IP, co-development and work-for-hire• Hold terms to the close. When a deal doesn’t fit, rethink it instead of forcing it• Own our presence at D.I.C.E., GDC and Gamescom: the plan, the meetings, the follow-ups• Take over and grow our relationships with first-party platforms, major publishers and tool providers• Be the senior sparring partner for our Biz team: review deal rationales, mentor, keep commitments visible• Bring what you hear in the market back into the groupYour profile:• A seat in the circles where games deals happen: D.I.C.E., GamesBeat, or their equivalents in LA and Asia. Established, or clearly on your way in• Relationships at Director or VP level and above, across more than one segment: publishers, platforms, investors or tool providers• At least one deal in the last three years that you originated or led to the close• A confident presence in front of C-level. Quick and sharp• Drive. You set your own goals and get things done through people, without direct reports• Readiness to travel a lot, and the energy to enjoy it• A real feel for entertainment. You play games• Business-fluent English. German is a bonusNice to have:• Experience with funding, licensing or joint ventures• You’ve sat on both sides of the table, developer and publisher• You’ve worked in an owner-led company• You already use AI for research, prep and follow-upsWho this is not for• You want to build and lead a team from day one• You need a big brand behind you to get a meeting• You’d rather have a clear job description than build somethingAbout usTo find out more about remote control productions go to our website: www.rcp.familyand sign up for our newsletter !What we offer:• Real influence: a direct line to the CEO and a voice in group strategy• Where it can go: stay the face of rcp, lead one of our partner studios, or help make our own games• Fixed pay, no commission. You’re paid to build the right deals, not to push the most deals through• A family of game makers across three continents• Munich or remote: work from our office in the heart of Munich, or remotely from Europe or North America on European hours. Permanent employment or freelance, whichever fits you and your country• Health coaching with OLAO HEALTH. In Munich: Deutschlandticket, a games library and team events
