Faculty of Mathematics and Natural SciencesPhD Student Position (f/m/x) in “Quantum Hall calorimetry of quantum materials“Institute of Physics II | Bocquillon Working GroupWe are one of the largest and oldest universities in Europe and one of the most important employers in our region. Our broad range of subjects, the dynamic development of our main research areas and our central location in Cologne make us attractive for students and researchers from around the world. We offer a wide range of career opportunities in science, technology, and administration.One PhD Student position is available in the group of Professor Erwann Bocquillon, which specializes in the quantum transport of quantum materials(https://ph2.uni-koeln.de/en/research-groups/bocquillon).The University of Cologne promotes equal opportunities and diversity. Women will be considered preferentially in accordance with the Equal Opportunities Act of North Rhine-Westphalia (Landesgleichstellungsgesetz - LGG NRW). We also expressly welcome applications from all suitable candidates regardless of their gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, disability, age, personal orientation and identity.The position is available from 1 January 2027 on a part-time basis (29,87 hours per week).The position is to be filled for a fixed term until 31 December 2029. If the applicant meets the relevant wage requirements and personal qualifications, the salary is based on remuneration group 13 TV-L of the pay scale for the German public sector.Please apply online with proof of the required qualifications without a photo via the apply button. The reference number is Wiss2610-07. The application deadline is 30 November 2026.For further inquiries, please contact Professor Dr Erwann Bocquillon (bocquillon@ph2.uni-koeln.de) (scientific part) or Dr Matteo Cacco (cacco@ph2.uni-koeln.de) (application questions) and take a look at our FAQs. YOUR TASKSThis PhD project will develop a new ultra-sensitive quantum calorimeter to explore how heat flows through exotic quantum materials. By combining layered crystals with quantum Hall devices, the researcher will be able to probe elusive states of matter with unprecedented precision-starting with alpha-RuCl3, a leading candidate for hosting Majorana-like particles and a quantum spin liquid. The project offers an opportunity to build new cutting-edge techniques in collaboration with partners at the University of Tokyo (Japan), while tackling some exciting open questions in condensed-matter physics.YOUR PROFILEThe candidate should possess an excellent academic record and hold a Masters in Physics, preferably with a major in Quantum Physics or Condensed Matter Physics. Research experience in one or several of the following fields will be appreciated: cryogenic systems, quantum transport measurements, nano-fabrication and cleanroom techniquesAn excellent command of English, as well as high motivation, commitment, good communication skills and team spirit are expected.WE OFFERAn exciting research project at the forefront of research on quantum matterA diverse working environment with equal opportunitiesSupport in balancing work and family lifeExtensive advanced training opportunitiesOccupational health management offersFlexible working time models

In interdisziplinären Teams gestalten wir zukunftsweisende Forschung, innovative Lehre sowie den aktiven Wissenstransfer in die Gesellschaft. Unseren Beschäftigten in Forschung, Lehre, Technik und Verwaltung bieten wir ein lebendiges, familienfreundliches und chancengerechtes Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und vielfältigen Möglichkeiten. Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft!In der Fakultät für Elektrotechnik, Informatik und Mathematik ist am Institut für Informatik – Fachgruppe Rechnerarchitektur – zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine Stelle alswissenschaftliche*r Mitarbeiter*in (w/m/d)(Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L)im Umfang von 100 % der regelmäßigen Arbeitszeit zu besetzen. Es handelt sich um eine Qualifizierungsstelle im Sinne des Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetzes (WissZeitVG), die zur Förderung eines Promotionsverfahrens dient. Die Stelle ist befristet, abhängig von der bisher erreichten Qualifizierung, jedoch für einen Zeitraum von i. d. R. 3 Jahren, zu besetzen. Eine Verlängerung ist innerhalb der Befristungsgrenzen des WissZeitVG ggf. möglich.Die Forschungsgruppe unter der Leitung von Prof. Dr.-Ing. jobs.description: This is a new, dedicated Commercial Sales Manager (m/f/d) position created to provide specialized oversight for the Erfurt factory's generator business. The role addresses the need for focused commercial management due to an expanding product portfolio, including electric motors and maritime applications, and increasing complexity in external projects with international clients. To meet these business objectives, the role is structured around three core areas: comprehensive Commercial Offer and Bid Management for all projects, rigorous Sales Process and Financial Governance using tools like Salesforce and PATAC, and proactive Stakeholder and Risk Management to navigate complex international requirements and ensure seamless collaboration between technical and commercial teams. Given the focus on these areas, the ideal candidate will be a subject matter expert with extensive experience in commercial sales and contract management within an industrial manufacturing context. A proven ability to manage complex international projects, including financial calculations and risk mitigation, is essential for success in this role.How You’ll Make an Impact- Lead the development and preparation of commercial offers for all internal and external generator, electric motor, and maritime application projects originating from the Erfurt factory.- Structure, draft, and negotiate complex sales contracts, amendments, and bid documents in collaboration with technical sales, legal, and business management teams.- Manage the end-to-end bid and proposal process, ensuring all submissions are competitive, compliant, and aligned with strategic business objectives.- Develop and implement pricing strategies and perform detailed cost calculations for all tenders and proposals.- Manage all commercial sales activities and pipeline information within Salesforce, ensuring data accuracy and generating regular sales reports.- Execute and oversee core commercial processes, including the Project Approval and Tender Approval Committee (PATAC) workflow, bond applications, and financial clearances.- Ensure the fulfillment of contractual financial obligations, coordinating with finance on topics such as invoicing and payment terms.- Continuously improve commercial sales processes to enhance efficiency and mitigate risks.- Serve as the primary commercial liaison for key external clients, managing complex requirements related to international tax issues, permanent establishment (PE) setup, and local installation services.- Collaborate closely with the technical sales team to ensure proposed solutions are commercially viable and to prevent execution problems on complex projects.- Identify, assess, and mitigate commercial, financial, and contractual risks throughout the entire sales cycle.- Coach and delegate work to lower-level professionals, acting as a subject matter expert for commercial sales processes.What You Bring- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.- Several years of experience in a senior commercial sales, contract management, or bid management role, preferably within the power generation or heavy industrial equipment sector.- Demonstrated experience managing large, complex international projects and navigating associated tax, legal, and logistical challenges.- Proficiency with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and financial calculation tools is required.- German and English fluency.Rewards/Benefits- In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme- We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder- We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity- The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. able to assess systems with limited explainability and incomplete scenario coverage- Broad knowledge of automotive development processes, including requirements engineering, configuration and change management, validation planning, tool qualification and evidence management; experienced in audits, assessments, confirmation reviews and independent technical evaluations- Consulting, pre-sales, business acquisition and bid-process experience, combined with strong analytical judgement, a structured auditor mindset, customer orientation and excellent communication skills; fluent in German and English, with willingness to travel internationally.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher Localized Electrochemistry, SECM, for Unraveling Degradation of Light Metals (Ingenieur/in - Materialwissenschaften)
jobs.description: Metal degradation can be a boon or a bane, depending on the application and on how well we can control it. A corroding car component is a safety risk. A biodegradable magnesium implant that dissolves at exactly the right rate spares patients a second surgery. An aqueous battery lives or dies depending on what happens at its electrodes.At the Department of Electrochemistry and Big Data we unravel degradation pathways of light metals used in structural applications, medical devices and aqueous batteries. Since metal degradation is governed by interface reactions, local electrochemical methods, which measure the concentrations of species generated or consumed at the metal/electrolyte interface, provide valuable insight into electrochemical degradation mechanisms.This position is created to employ a talented and motivated scientist able to run local electrochemical measurements using scanning electrochemical microscopy (SECM) and scanning electrochemical cell microscopy (SECCM). You will investigate how metals degrade in electrolytes ranging from simple model solutions to complex, physiologically relevant media. You will combine commercial and self-made amperometric and potentiometric micro-probes and micro-optodes to separate anodic and cathodic degradation pathways. You will also correlate your electrochemical data with surface chemistry and morphology.We are offering a 3‑year position, as soon as possible, as a Post-Doctoral researcher in the field of localized electroanalytical analysis. In principle, the position is full-time (39 h/week) and will be located in Hereon's main campus, in Geesthacht (near Hamburg).We value diversity and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. We particularly encourage qualified women to apply.Your tasks- Set up and commission new customized SECM/SECCM system, and manage our established SVET/SIET localized electrochemistry facility- Design, fabricate and characterize micro- and nano-electrodes tailored to required experiments using the techniques above- Contribute to ongoing research projects in close collaboration with the principal investigators, while developing and pursuing your own research ideas- Publish your results in leading peer-reviewed journals and present them at international conferences, write project reports- Shape the digital future of our lab by connecting the localized electrochemistry instruments to our electronic lab notebook and establishing FAIR data management- Co-supervise PhD students and help them grow as researchers- Write or contribute to grant proposals and build your own track record in acquiring external fundingYour profile- A PhD in electrochemistry, physical chemistry, materials science or a related field- Hands-on experience with SECM (SECCM experience is a strong plus), demonstrated through first-author publications- Experience fabricating micro- or nanoelectrodes for SECM/SECCM- Solid experimental skills in the chemical laboratory and confidence in quantitative data analysis using appropriate software- Experience with the degradation or corrosion of metallic materials, especially light metals, (experience with biodegradable metals or metallic medical devices is a strong plus)- Fluent written and spoken English is required, knowledge of the German language is preferred but not mandatory, we support language learningContent-related enquiries regarding this position can be directed to Sviatlana.Lamaka@hereon.de.Our offer- Access to state-of-the-art (robotic) labs, unique scientific and technical infrastructure- Access to a large international research and industrial network.- Funding for conferences, summer schools and courses needed or research stays- An exciting job in a research center with around 1,000 employees from more than 60 nations- International Welcome Office with guest accommodation- 6 weeks holiday per year; company holidays between The University Hospital Essen offers first class medical services in the Ruhr metropolis. Every year, 225.000 patients are treated in 30 clinics, 27 institutes and specialized centers. The over 8.000 employees offer medical care with state-of-the-art diagnosis and therapies, which meet highest international standards. Patient care is connected with basic and translational research at an internationally competitive level.Hemoglobin is best known for its role in oxygen transport in red blood cells. Our preliminary findings indicate that it is also expressed by lung immune cells, where it may contribute to antiviral defense. These findings further suggest that the thrombospondin-1 (TSP-1)/CD47 signaling axis limits hemoglobin expression and its associated antiviral antivity.The project aims to uncover the molecular mechanisms underlying hemoglobin-mediated antiviral defense and determine how this response is regulated by TSP-1/CD47 signaling. Combining mechanistic studies with in vivo models, we will explore whether targeting this pathway can enhance antiviral immunity while avoiding excessive inflammation and lung tissue damage.At the Insitute of Medical Microbiology (working group of PD Dr. Torben Knuschke), we are therefore offering the following position, which is fully funded by the German Research Foundation (DFG) and will start on 1 January 2027Perform in vitro and in vivo experiments to characterize the intrinsic and extrinsic (paracrine) funtions of hemoglobin in lung immune and epithelial cellsApply molecular biology techniquesPlan, perform, and analyze therapeutic intervention studiesPresent research findings at national and international conferences and contribute to peer-reviewed publicationsAssist in supervising Bachelors/Masters studentsA completed Master´s degree (or equivalent) in Biology, Molecular Medicine, Immunology, Biochemistry, or a related fieldSolid background in cell culture and standard molecular biology techniquesExperience in laboratory animal science (FELASA B) is an advantageStrong interest in basic research in Virology/ImmunologyIndependent, structured, and team-oriented working-styleExcellent written and spoken English skills; German language skills are a plus but not requiredAn exciting, methodologically diverse PhD project in an internationally visible research fieldDedicated supervision of the doctoral project within a cooperative working group with regular seminarsState-of-the-art laboratory infrastructure at University Hospital EssenInterdisciplinary work with colleagues from other departmentsEnrollment into the Graduate School for Biomedical Sciences BIOME (https://www.uni-due.de/biome)Salary according to the German public sector pay scale (TV-L, E13, 65%), fixed-term for 3 yearsA collegial working environment that encourages independent scientific ideasFamily-friendly corporate culture

The successful applicants will work in close collaboration with experienced research technicians and scientists at different levels and they will cultivate and characterize developmental traits in plant strains derived from mutagenesis and wild collections as well as transgenic plants. They will also be involved in generation of new transgenic plants. Experience in molecular biology (genomic DNA extraction, PCR, cloning), and in handling and cultivating plants, as well as experience with plant genetics is essential (further information on our research: https://www.mpipz.mpg.de/tsiantis). Additional tasks will involve maintaining lab genetic collections, preparing culture media and assisting in organizing and daily running of an S1 lab. The level of independent work and responsibility will depend on qualifications.Successful candidates will have completed professional training as either a research technician with first professional experience, or as a biology graduate (B.Sc. in plant genetics or an equivalent discipline) with work experience or an additional educational qualification. jobs.occupation: Position for a Postdoc (m/f/d) at the Chair of International Political Studies (Politologe/Politologin)
jobs.description: Position for a Postdoc (m/f/d) at the Chair of International Political StudiesUniverisity of Witten/HerdeckeWitten/Herdecke University (UW/H) is Germany’s first privately funded university. It was founded in 1982 and has since established itself as a leading educational institution in Germany. Today, the university employs more than 900 staff members, and a total of 3,700 students are enrolled in the Faculties of Health Sciences and of Economics and Social Sciences in Witten.Job descriptionThe team at the Chair of International Political Studies examines the causes and consequences of political violence. Its research focuses on questions regarding the relationship between conflict prevention strategies—such as power-sharing—and the risk of civil war in ethnically divided societies, as well as the impact of local political violence on voter preferences in OECD countries.To strengthen our team, we are seeking a PostDoc (m/f/d) to join the Chair of International Political Studies, starting April 1, 2027. The position (40h/ - 100%) is limited to 2 years.We are looking for an researcher who wants to develop their research agenda, which is not limited to the priorities of the research group. The position comes with a large amount of freedom to work on your own research priorities. We expect openness towards developing joint research projects that translate into funding applications. We offer participation in an active research network, the Conflict Research Exchange Workshop (CREW), international conference funding, and the possibility of remote work.Your tasksYou develop your own research profile in the field of international relations, historical political economy, or comparative politics, you support third party funding applications, and you teach one seminar per year (2 hours/week in one semester).Your profile- You have an an excellent doctoral degree in political science, economics, or related disciplines, or are about to complete your dissertation- You have an excellent command of English, strong knowledge of statistics, quantitative empirical social research, and causal research designs, as well as proficiency in R or Python- You showcase the ability to work both as part of a team and independently.- Relevant publications or experience in working in scientific projects are desirable.Wir bieten- Zusätzliche freie Brückentage- Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie- Direkter Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung- Verschiedene Bezuschussungen- Weiterbildung- Umweltfreundliche MobilitätsmöglichkeitenContactIf this opportunity aligns with your goals, please apply unit 24th November 2026, exclusively online, including the standard application documents (Resume without a photo, relevant transcripts, two academic papers or chapters from your doctoral dissertation, and contact information for two references) and your proposed start date.We look forward to receiving your application.Prof. Nils-Christian Bormann  | Professor of International Political Studies | nils.bormann@uni-wh.deConcept of diversityWe explicitly live and promote the idea of diversity (www.uni-wh.de/diversity (http://www.uni-wh.de/diversity) ). jobs.employer_name: GlobalFoundries Management Services GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: About GF  GlobalFoundries® Inc. (GF®) is one of the world's leading semiconductor manufacturers. GF redefines innovation and semiconductor manufacturing by developing and delivering feature-rich process technology solutions with leading performance in all growth markets. GF offers a unique mix of design, development and manufacturing services. With a talented and diverse team and manufacturing locations in the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted technology provider to its global customers. GF employs approximately 13,000 people, including more than 3,000 in Dresden, Germany.For more information, visit hier .IntroductionFab1 Reliability team is a multinational team, with members from various places of the world with experience in state of the art reliability methodologies, technology qualification & product monitoring.We are seeking an experienced RRAM Reliability Engineer to support the development, qualification, and production deployment of advanced embedded Resistive RAM (RRAM) technologies. The successful candidate will define and execute reliability qualification strategies, investigate failure mechanisms, develop reliability models, and work closely with integration, device, process, product engineering, and customer teams to ensure robust RRAM solutions for automotive, industrial, and IoT applications.Your JobReliability Qualification & Assessment- Develop and execute RRAM technology qualification plans.- Design and execute reliability stress tests including:- Develop lifetime prediction and reliability models using statistical techniques.- Support customer reliability assessments and qualification deliverables.- Define reliability requirements and qualification criteria for new RRAM products and technology nodes.- Establish screening and monitoring methodologies for RRAM manufacturing.Failure Analysis & Root Cause Investigation- Investigate RRAM failure mechanisms and switching degradation behavior.- Lead root-cause analysis activities involving electrical, physical, and material characterization.- Correlate device performance with process, integration, and material variations.- Drive corrective and preventive actions to improve reliability margins.Technology Development Support- Collaborate with FEOL, BEOL, integration, device, modeling, and manufacturing teams.- Support optimization of RRAM switching conditions and operating windows.- Evaluate new material stacks, dopants, and process changes for reliability impact.Required Qualifications- Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, Microelectronics, or related discipline.- 5+ years of semiconductor NVM reliability experience.- Direct experience with:- Knowledge of:- Programming skills in Python, VBA, or advanced statistical tools.We Offer  The position is open-ended and to be filled as soon as possible.    Attractive compensation components:   13th month salary, bonus payments, assistance with relocation to Dresden. jobs.occupation: Research Associate (PhD position) for the DFG project (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: Ihre AufgabenThe University of Bonn is an international research university offering a broad range of subjects. With a 200-year history, some 31,500 students, more than 6,000 employees and an outstanding reputation in Germany and abroad, the University of Bonn is one of the leading universities in Germany and has been awarded the status of a University of Excellence.The Department of Southeastasia is looking to fill the following position from January 1st, 2027, or as soon as possible, initially on a fixed-term contract according to § 2(1) WissZeitVG until December, 31, 2029Research Associate (PhD position) for the DFG project (65%)Working the Plantationocene. Ecological Labour Regimes of the Palm Oil Value Chain (PALMWORK)PALMWORK examines the relationship between labour and the environment along the palm oil value chain, particularly in the areas of production (plantations and oil mills) and social reproduction. The project is designed as a qualitative comparative analysis of case studies from Northeast India, Ghana and Colombia. It builds on re-search from the fields of labour regime analysis, (feminist) labour geography, environmental labour studies and political ecology on the materiality of nature and the society–nature metabolism. The project is being carried out as part of the DFG Priority Programme 2575 'Sustainability and Resilience of Agri-Food Chains' and consists of three sub-projects located at the University of Bonn, the Free University of Berlin and the University of Kassel. The position is for the sub-project in Northeast India, and is based at Bonn University.Tasks:- Field research with plantation and mill workers in North-East India- Contribution to joint publications- Contribution to science communicationProfile:- A completed academic degree (Master's) in the social sciences or earth sci-ences (political science, human geography, regional studies, sociology or equivalent)- Willingness to conduct independent field research in Northeast India- Very good spoken and written English- Good communication and teamwork skills- Intercultural and diversity competenceDesirable:- Experience of conducting independent research in India- Good knowledge of qualitative research methods- Experience with working and researching with (palm oil) workers- Good command of a language spoken in Northeast India (e.g. Assamese, Bengali, Nepali)- Good knowledge of the project's research area (political ecology, political economy, analysis of labour regimes, environmental labour studies, labour ge ography)What we offer:- Opportunity to pursue a PhD- Be part of a cutting-edge research team- Be part of a larger network of scholars in the DFG Special Programme- Flexible working hours and the ability to work from home- Remuneration in accordance with TV-L pay grade 13The University of Bonn promotes an open, respectful, and non-discriminatory academic culture and is actively committed to equal opportunity and family friendliness. We aim to eliminate structural disadvantages and to strengthen diversity in research, teaching, and administration. Therefore, we welcome all applications, regard-less of ethnic or social background, gender, sexual orientation, religion or belief, disability, or age.Applications from women and people with a documented severe disability (or equivalent status) will be given preferential consideration in accordance with the State Equality Act (LGG) NRW and Social Code (SGB) IXProject start is January 1st, 2027. Please send your application (with motivation letter, CV and writing sample (if available) with the application code 2026/447 to opye@uni-bonn.de. Application deadline is 22th November, 2026.

Who We Are 🌍Limatica measures what batteries whisper. We turn the tiny voltage noise of battery cells into a quality verdict, far faster than conventional tests, and help cell manufacturers cut scrap.We are a team of twelve in Chemnitz, spanning data, ML, HPC, hardware and industrialization. Early adopters across Europe and Asia already use our technology. In 2026 we move from pilots to production lines, and our data grows faster than our team.What You'll Do 🔧Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. As we grow, this role can grow into technical lead.- Learn what few get to learn: Electrochemistry, Rust in production and data engineering at scale, with real cells and international manufacturers.- Share the upside: Salary package including virtual stock options.- Invest in yourself: Additional holiday for personal learning- Flexibility & wellbeing: Flexible hours, hybrid work, further benefits via Guud CardWhat it's like here: You get a lot of trust and a lot of room to shape things. This role is intentionally a towards-senior position. You will take on increasing responsibility for pipeline modules and customer projects. jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Together, we are simplifying our structures, strengthening the accountability of Therapeutic Areas, and creating clear interfaces between Innovation and Business. This ensures that our assets are efficiently transformed into successful brands - with the ultimate goal of delivering lasting value to patients around the world.We are looking for an experienced physician-scientist to lead the clinical development of an innovative oncology asset. You combine strong analytical skills and technical curiosity with a high affinity for data, computers and digital tools. At the same time, you communicate your findings effectively and enjoy collaborating with experts across different functions.Qualifications and skills to help you succeed- A university degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry or a comparable technical discipline- At least 3–5 years of professional experience in the semiconductor industry, ideally in Product Engineering- Excellent Product Engineering expertise and experience in yield improvement, quality enhancement and physical failure analysis- Strong data affinity and analytical curiosity, with the motivation to dig deep into complex datasets and technical challenges and systematically investigate root causes- Experience in correlating different data sources and parameters, combined with strong computer and tool affinity- Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills, as well as confident communication in both English and German#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity.Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/) and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/) at Infineon.Nicole Hippmann

We are looking for a highly motivated and proactive Supplier Quality Manager (Europe) (d/f/m) at our site in Hemer or Düsseldorf to establish and maintain a robust quality ecosystem across our European supplier base. This role requires a strategic mindset to drive supplier quality improvements, mitigate risks, and ensure compliance with LIXIL standards and processes. The ideal candidate will have strong cross-functional collaboration skills and a passion for innovation in quality management. Key responsibilities and main challenges:·         Implement advanced supplier quality control processes to enhance supplier performance and achieve key performance indicators (KPIs).·         Develop preventive risk mitigation processes using APQP methodologies and predictive analytics.·         Support key suppliers in establishing quality firewalls through periodic training and continuous improvement initiatives.·         Assist the sourcing team in supplier selection and evaluation through audits and performance monitoring.·         Conduct supplier audits based on VDA6.1 and VDA6.3.·         Collaborate with the regional quality team on new product development quality, focusing on PPAP/ISIR verification.·         Analyze supplier quality issues and drive corrective actions using 8D, 5-Why, and APDCA methodologies.·         Continuously monitor and improve supplier quality performance.·         Validate key supplier laboratories according to specifications and standards.·         Lead competency development and internal training for the European SQM team. Your profile:·         Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Technology or Engineering.·         Certified VDA6.1/IATF16949 and VDA6.3 Auditor.·         Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in quality management leadership within a manufacturing environment. Experience in the electronics or automotive industry is preferred.·         Advanced knowledge and application of AIAG/VDA Core Tools (e.g., APQP, FMEA, SPC, and MSA).·         Strong problem-solving skills with expertise in methodologies such as 5W1H and 8D.·         A proactive and open-minded team player with excellent communication skills.·         Strong proficiency in English and German (written and spoken).·         Willingness to travel within Germany and across Europe (approximately 40%). US product, packaging and labeling legislation, including GPSR, the EU Textile Labelling Regulation, EU packaging law (PPWR, national EPR) and US FTC textile, care and country-of-origin labeling rules• Own materials, packaging and labeling compliance for every product, from fabric, cartons and polybags to hangtags, care labels and product labels, including importer and manufacturer identification and traceability• Review and release supplier artwork and packaging proofs before production and before shipment• Establish governance processes, standards and controls so requirements are applied consistently across brands, suppliers and markets• Act as internal counterpart to external legal counsel and EPR/packaging registration partners• Maintain technical documentation and compliance records, including GPSR Responsible Person duties and retention obligations• Manage non-conformities with suppliers, from root cause analysis to corrective actions, and train Buying, Product and the sourcing team on requirementsWHY YOU WOULD BE A GOOD FIT FOR US• Degree or vocational training in Law, Textile or Product Management, Supply Chain Management, Business or a related field, or comparable practical experience in product compliance• Work experience in a similar position, ideally in apparel, textiles or consumer goods sold in the EU and US• Ability to read and apply regulatory text directly, not only checklists, and turn it into clear requirements for suppliers and teams• Hands-on experience with artwork and packaging approval processes• Working knowledge of HS/TARIC classification is a plus• Structured and detail-focused, with a good mix of analytical and operational thinking• Fluent German and English• Willingness to work from our headquarters in Düsseldorf at least 4 days per weekWHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT CFAB• Permanent employment contract• 31 vacation days• Flexible working hours• Apple equipment (MacBook, iPhone)• Employer-paid team lunch three times a week• Monthly tax-free benefits of your choice• Corporate Benefits and discounts• Manicure and barber appointments at the office• Monthly product vouchers• Optional company car after the probation period• Personal birthday voucher• Regular team events and celebrations• Plenty of room for your own ideas, ownership and active contributionWHAT MOTIVATES USAt cfab ambition and speed go hand in hand with high standards for our work. We don’t just want to develop ideas: we want to bring them to life quickly and see what comes of them. For us, it’s not just about good ideas, but above all about the results they produce.Our growth is driven by people who set high standards, drive things forward, and want to grow alongside us. Here you’ll have the space to take on responsibility, develop your skills, and make your own impact visible.READY TO CREATE WHAT’S NEXT?Let’s make it happen.

jobs.employer_name: Rheinland-Pfälzische Techn. Univers. Kaiserslautern-Landau Standort Landau
jobs.description: With about 15,000 students, more than 300 professorships and around 160 degree programs, the RPTU University Kaiserslautern-Landau is the technical university of the state of Rhineland-Palatinate. As a place of top international research, it offers excellent working conditions and career opportunities. Those who study, research or work at RPTU experience a cosmopolitan environment and shape the future.As part of the DFG-funded project Energy Structures: Energy Sustains Dissipative Structures in Soil Systems (https://soilsystems.net/projects-partners/2-p1-energy-structures/), the RPTU in Landau and the Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research (UFZ) in Leipzig jointly offer a PhD position.Place of work: 50% at RPTU in Landau (32.5%) and 50% at UFZ in Leipzig (32.5%), according to agreement and project requirementsYour area of responsibility:The aim of the project is to understand how and under which conditions carbon and energy are transformed and stored in soils. Through incubation experiments and thermodynamic modelling, you will quantify matter and energy fluxes and characterize their efficiency and limitations. In doing so, you will investigate how energy inputs from organic substrates affect dissipative processes in soil microbial communities and whether dissipative structures develop in soils that govern matter and energy fluxes and thereby promote soil carbon storage.To achieve this aim, you will primarily work with a newly developed calorespirometric system at RPTU in Landau, which you will also further develop. In Leipzig, you will work with a newly developed plug-flow reaction calorimeter at UFZ. The measurements will be complemented by key chemical and biological analyses of the soil and its microbial community, including isothermal microcalorimetry (IMC), thermogravimetry–differential scanning calorimetry–quadrupole mass spectrometry (TG-DSC-QMS), phospholipid fatty acid (PLFA) analyses, elemental analyses and molecular biological analyses.The project is part of the DFG Priority Programme SPP 2322 SoilSystems (https://soilsystems.net/). You will benefit from the interdisciplinary collaboration within the programme's nationwide research consortium. Close collaboration, in particular with Trier University, is also planned.We offer:- Top-level research at the interface between research centre and university, with an excellent reputation nationally and internationally- The opportunity to benefit from the expertise of two research institutions- Excellent technical infrastructure and equipment- Work in interdisciplinary and international teams- Excellent connections to national and international research networks- Comprehensive support and optimal training courses by our graduate schools (HIGRADE at UFZ and ZGaPL at RPTU)- Salary according to the German public sector pay scale TVöD/TV-L, pay grade E13 (65%)Your requirements profile:- Master's degree or equivalent in soil science, environmental sciences, biochemistry, biology, chemistry, or a related field- Strong interest in complex and interdisciplinary processes in soil systems- Interest, willingness and ability to integrate new scientific concepts into soil science research- Prior experience in one or more of the following areas is an advantage, but not a prerequisite: soil science, environmental microbiology, calorimetry, and thermodynamics; Willingness to expand your expertise into complementary fields is expected- Curiosity and openness to learning new methods, critically evaluating and further developing existing approaches, and exploring new methodological solutions- Willingness to independently learn new methods, troubleshoot and develop creative solutions to methodological challenges- Openness to incorporating modelling approaches and aspects of microbial ecology into your research- Willingness to work in an interdisciplinary and international team- Very good written and spoken English skillsMore informations given on our homepage:https://jobs.rptu.de/jobposting/f03b170329d9425cfa5355ad0c4fe4ba72fea9bb0 (https://jobs.rptu.de/jobposting/f03b170329d9425cfa5355ad0c4fe4ba72fea9bb0)We look forward to receiving your detailed application (CV, references, etc.) by 15.11.2026 at the latest.The job interviews are scheduled to take place in calendar weeks 48 and 49.Deutsche Version:Die Rheinland-Pfälzische Technische Universität Kaiserslautern-Landau (RPTU) ist mit rund 15.000 Studierenden, mehr als 300 Professuren und rund 160 Studiengängen die Technische Universität des Landes Rheinland-Pfalz. Als Ort internationaler Spitzenforschung bietet sie exzellente Arbeitsbedingungen und Karrierechancen. Wer an der RPTU lernt, forscht oder arbeitet, erlebt ein weltoffenes Umfeld und gestaltet die Zukunft.Im Rahmen des von der DFG geförderten Projekts Energy Structures: Energy Sustains Dissipative Structures in Soil Systems (https://soilsystems.net/projects-partners/2-p1-energy-structures/) bieten die RPTU in Landau und das Helmholtz-Zentrum für Umweltforschung (UFZ) in Leipzig gemeinsam eine Promotionsstelle an.Arbeitsort: je zur Hälfte an der RPTU in Landau (32,5 %) und am UFZ in Leipzig (32,5%) nach Absprache und inhaltlicher Notwendigkeit.Ihr Aufgabengebiet:Ziel des Projektes ist es, zu verstehen, wie und unter welchen Bedingungen Kohlenstoff und Energie im Boden transformiert und gespeichert werden. Durch Inkubationsexperimente und thermodynamische Modellierung quantifizieren Sie die Stoff- und Energieflüsse und beschreiben deren Effizienz und Grenzen. Sie erforschen dadurch, wie der Energieeintrag durch organische Substrate dissipative Prozesse in mikrobiellen Gemeinschaften des Bodens beeinflusst und ob sich im Boden dissipative Strukturen ausbilden, welche Stoff- und Energieflüsse im Boden bestimmen und dadurch Kohlenstoffspeicherung im Boden fördern.Um dieses Ziel zu erreichen, arbeiten Sie schwerpunktmäßig mit einem neu entwickelten kalorespirometrischen System an der RPTU in Landau, das Sie auch weiterentwickeln werden. In Leipzig arbeiten Sie mit einem neu entwickelten Durchflussreaktionskalorimeter am UFZ in Leipzig. Die Messungen werden durch zentrale chemische und biologische Analysen des Bodens und seiner mikrobiellen Gemeinschaft ergänzt, unter anderem mittels isothermer Mikrokalorimetrie (IMC), Thermogravimetrie-Differenzkalorimetrie-Quadrupol-Massenspektrometrie (TG-DSC-QMS), PLFA-Analysen, Elementaranalysen und molekularbiologischer Analysen.Das Projekt ist Teil des DFG-Schwerpunktprogramms SPP 2322 „SoilSystems“ (https://soilsystems.net/). Sie profitieren von der interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit des überregionalen Konsortiums des Schwerpunktprogramms, zudem ist eine enge Zusammenarbeit insbesondere mit der Universität Trier geplant.Wir bieten:- Spitzenforschung an der Schnittstelle von Universität und außeruniversitärer Forschung mit exzellentem nationalem und internationalem Ruf- Sie profitieren von der Expertise zweier Forschungseinrichtungen- Hervorragende technische Ausstattung- Mitarbeit in interdisziplinären und internationalen Teams- Sehr gute Anbindung an nationale und internationale Forschungsnetzwerke- Umfassende Betreuung und optimale Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten durch unsere Graduiertenschulen (HIGRADE am UFZ und ZGaPL an der RPTUUnser Anforderungsprofil:- Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Master oder äquivalent - ausgenommen mit einem Bachelorgrad) der Bodenwissenschaften, Umweltwissenschaften, Biochemie, Biologie, Chemie oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet- starkes Interesse an komplexen und interdisziplinären Zusammenhängen in Bodensystemen- Interesse, Bereitschaft und Fähigkeit, in diesem Projekt neue naturwissenschaftliche Konzepte in die bodenwissenschaftliche Forschung zu integrieren- Vorerfahrungen in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung: Bodenkunde, Umweltmikrobiologie, Kalorimetrie und Thermodynamik; die Bereitschaft, die eigene Expertise auf komplementäre Fachgebiete auszuweiten, wird vorausgesetzt- Neugier und Offenheit, neue Methoden zu erlernen, bestehende Ansätze kritisch zu hinterfragen und weiterzuentwickeln sowie neue methodische Lösungen zu erkunden- Bereitschaft zum selbstständigen Einarbeiten, zur Fehlersuche und zur Entwicklung kreativer Lösungen für methodische Herausforderungen- Offenheit, Modellierungsansätze und Aspekte der mikrobiellen Ökologie in die eigene Forschung einzubeziehen- Bereitschaft zur Arbeit in einem interdisziplinären und internationalen Team- Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und SchriftWeitere Informationen finden Sie auf unserer Homepage:https://jobs.rptu.de/jobposting/f03b170329d9425cfa5355ad0c4fe4ba72fea9bb0 (https://jobs.rptu.de/jobposting/f03b170329d9425cfa5355ad0c4fe4ba72fea9bb0)Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

jobs.occupation: Ph.D. student (m/f/x): Data analysis for exotic hadrons at hadronic thresholds (Physiker/in)
jobs.description: In order to fill a fixed-term position in part-time (26.2878 hours/week = 66%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for 1Ph.D. student (m/f/x): Data analysis for exotic hadrons at hadronic thresholdsThe work of the chair of experimental physics 1 focuses on basic research: Oneof the most essential elements of todays education and research is to gain abetter understanding of the structure of matter and the fundamental principles ofnature. In this process the basic research of physics plays an important role as itprovides a base for technical innovations and development. Hadron Physicsdeals with strong interacting particles consisting of quarks and gluons. Amongthose hadrons also rank the building blocks of the atomic nucleus, the protonand the neutron. There are many other hadrons that can only be created viacollisions of high energetic particles in big particle accelerators. The created hadrons are detected by modern and complex detectors to examine their composition and interactions.The position is embedded in two research programs. DEMOS ("Democratizing Models") is an ErUM research initiative developing a federated, interoperable standard for describing, sharing and re-evaluating physics models across particle, hadron, nuclear, neutrino and astroparticle physics. Hadronic coupled-channel amplitudes are one of its flagship applications: they are analytically intricate and rarely reproducible from the publication alone, which makes them an ideal test case for the new standard. HADRON 2030 is an intercollaborative research network dedicated to studies of hadron physics. Within the ExHAT (Exploration of Heavy Hadrons at Thresholds) project, we will explore heavy hadrons at thresholds using spectroscopy methods with LHCb data and inclusive production studies with ALICE. The flagship case is the doubly charmed tetraquark Tcc(3875)+, which lies a fraction of an MeV below the D0D*+ threshold. Line shape, pole position, three-body DD-pi dynamics and isospin breaking have to be disentangled in a joint effort of theory and experiment.Scope: part-timeDuration: fixed-term, 3 yearsStart: at the earliest possible dateApply by:  2026-11-15Your tasks:- Application of advanced methods of data selection, efficiency and resolutionstudies within LHCb data analysis.- Construction, fitting and analytic continuation of coupled-channel scatteringamplitudes.- Decipherment and serialization of the complex amplitudes in the DEMOS / amplitude-serialization format.- Collaboration within the DEMOS / HADRON 2030 networks.- Exchange with the experimental collaborations [LHCb, BESIII, Belle II, GlueX, ...] and with EFT/lattice QCD groups.Your profile:- Master's degree (or equivalent) in physics, completed by the starting date.- Background in experimental particle physics or hadron physics, and familiarity with quantum field theory and scattering theory.- Good scientific programming skills (Julia, Python or C++) and experience with version control and reproducible workflows.- Very good command of written and spoken English.- Interest in working at the interface between theory and experiment and inopen, reusable research software.https://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/cfcd29d29c6781afa43ea9ee698bf39148ca1c4f0?ref=AfA (https://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/cfcd29d29c6781afa43ea9ee698bf39148ca1c4f0?ref=AfA)

jobs.description: Shape compliance. Drive governance. Protect global business. At DHL Group, we connect people and improve lives through our global logistics network. Behind our world-leading operations stands a strong commitment to governance, compliance, and risk management. We are looking for an experienced Manager of Insurance Tax, Regulation & Compliance Germany (m/f/d) to play a pivotal role in ensuring that our insurance activities remain compliant, transparent, and future-ready. This position combines insurance taxation, regulatory compliance, governance, and stakeholder management in a highly international environment. Manager of Insurance Tax, Regulation & Compliance Germany (m/f/d)   Why experienced insurance professionals join this role* Move from advising to owning insurance governance decisions.* Shape multinational insurance programs across a global organization.* Influence strategic decisions involving Tax, Legal, Treasury, Procurement, and Risk Management.* Work at the intersection of insurance, regulation, governance, and business strategy.* Gain exposure to some of the most complex international insurance arrangements in the market. You'll make an impact by:* Defining and evolving DHL Group's global insurance governance framework.* Ensuring regulatory excellence across international insurance programs.* Leading complex tax, regulatory, and compliance initiatives.* Managing interactions with authorities, regulators, auditors, brokers, and insurers.* Providing strategic guidance on multinational insurance structures and cross-border risk solutions. What You Will Do:Insurance Tax & Compliance* Serve as the central expert for insurance premium tax matters in Germany.* Advise business stakeholders on insurance taxation, insurance distribution compliance, and regulatory requirements.* Assess domestic and international insurance programs, including multinational insurance structures, global master policies, local policies, captive insurance arrangements, and Freedom of Services (FOS) solutions.* Review and evaluate insurance premium tax treatment for insurance contracts and insurance-related services.* Support the design, implementation, and launch of new insurance programs while ensuring tax and regulatory compliance. Governance & Risk Management* Maintain and continuously improve insurance tax governance and compliance frameworks.* Design and oversee internal control systems for insurance premium tax processes.* Contribute to the enhancement of DHL Group's Tax Compliance Management System.* Conduct risk assessments and compliance reviews related to insurance distribution and taxation.* Promote transparency, documentation standards, and audit readiness across the organization.  Regulatory & Audit Management* Manage insurance premium tax audits and regulatory reviews independently.* Act as the primary contact for tax authorities, auditors, legal advisors, insurers, and brokers.* Develop strategies to address audit findings and mitigate regulatory risks.* Monitor developments in German and international insurance tax legislation and relevant court decisions.* Ensure regulatory awareness and compliance regarding insurance distribution activities in Germany. Cross-Functional Collaboration* Work closely with colleagues from Tax, Legal, Treasury, Procurement, Risk Management, and other business functions.* Support DHL business units in understanding and meeting insurance compliance requirements.* Coordinate with external advisors, brokers, insurers, and regulatory stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions. What You Bring* University degree in Law, Tax, Business Administration, Finance, Insurance, Risk Management, or a related field.* Several years of professional experience in insurance taxation, insurance regulation, compliance, risk management, legal, or related disciplines.* Proven expertise in German Insurance Premium Tax (IPT) regulations and insurance compliance requirements.* Experience managing regulatory inquiries, audits, disputes, and complex multinational insurance programs.* Strong understanding of commercial insurance products, including Property, Liability, Marine, Cargo, Cyber, D&O, Financial Lines, and Employee Benefits.* Experience developing governance, control, and compliance frameworks in international organizations.* Excellent English language skills and good German language proficiency. Who You AreYou are a strategic and analytical professional who enjoys navigating complex regulatory environments. You combine technical expertise with strong stakeholder management skills and are comfortable advising senior decision-makers. You thrive in international settings, communicate effectively, and maintain the highest standards of integrity and quality. What We Offer* A highly visible role with global impact across one of the world's leading logistics companies.* Exposure to complex international insurance, tax, and compliance topics.* Opportunities to collaborate with senior stakeholders across multiple functions and regions.* A diverse, inclusive, and collaborative working environment.* Continuous professional development and career growth opportunities within DHL Group.(Employer value proposition formulated based on the role's global scope and responsibilities.) Why DHL Group?At DHL Group, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can contribute and grow. We value diverse perspectives and believe that our people are the key to our success. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, skills, experience, and performance. Your benefits * Well-Being: Fun, team spirit, and health are crucial factors. Therefore, within the company, we offer a wide range of health and preventive care services, an occupational physician* Family-friendly: The compatibility of family and work has many facets, such as childcare, care for family members, etc. We support this, for example, through kindergarten places as well as the Betreuungs- und Erholungswerk (support and recreation program).* Employee Share Program: As an employee, you have the opportunity to participate in DHL Group's employee share program and share directly in the company's long-term success.* Mobility: We move not only letters or parcels but also our employees through offerings such as company bicycles, job tickets and possibly company cars.* Location: The Post Campus brings together people from more than 60 countries. The Post Tower is easily accessible by car, public transportation and bicycle. To facilitate the workday, the campus offers amenities such as parking spaces, post office, café, canteen and more.* Onboarding: Individual onboarding, training on the job, networking, a dedicated certified program, etc., lay the foundation for a successful start at DHL Group.* Development opportunities: We offer numerous development opportunities through a comprehensive training landscape, junior talent programs, coaching etc.* Social commitment: Through global corporate programs, we improve the educational and career opportunities for young people and engage in disaster management at airports. We also contribute to local environmental protection and aid projects initiated by employees on a voluntary basis.* What else? Company pension plan, social counseling, inclusion consulting, cleaning service, insurance cooperation, corporate discounts, events, sabbaticals and much more! About DHL GroupDHL Group is the world’s leading logistics company, connecting people and businesses in more than 220 countries and territories through a comprehensive portfolio of logistics, e-commerce, parcel, express, freight forwarding, and supply chain management services.With approximately 580,000 employees worldwide, DHL Group operates one of the largest global logistics networks.Our purpose is simple: Connecting People. Improving Lives. Apply now with your complete documents, stating your salary expectations, using the application button. For further information, please visit careers.dhl.com. For initial personal contact and any questions, please contact Sven Rötzel at sven.roetzel@dhl.com or 0228-189-52128. We look forward to receiving your application*.CONNECTING PEOPLE. IMPROVING LIVES. *At DHL Group, applications from all individuals are welcome, regardless of age, gender, origin, religion or physical attributes.

B. Bürgschaften)- Zusammenarbeit mit Projektmanagement und Finance- Steuerung externer Kanzleien- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von BGB, VOB/B und FIDICIhr Profil- Du bist Volljurist und bringst die nötige Qualifikation für die Position mit- Deine fundierten Kenntnisse im Vertragsrecht ermöglichen es Dir, komplexe rechtliche Sachverhalte zu verstehen und zu bearbeiten- 5–10+ Jahre Erfahrung im Bau- oder Infrastrukturrecht- Erfahrung mit EPC-Verträgen- Erfahrung im Claim-Management- Wirtschaftliches Verständnis- Englisch fließendWir bieten - Großprojekte im Bereich BESS & Hochspannung  - Direkter Kontakt zu Netzbetreibern  - Hohe Verantwortung  - Attraktive Vergütung und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten  - Langfristige Perspektiven Bitte senden Sie Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen an: careers@promergon.com (https://mailto:careers@promergon.com/)  About UsPROMERGON GmbH is an internationally operating company specializing in energy infrastructure and EPC projects, based in Düsseldorf. EPC contracts- Subcontractor agreements- Framework agreements- Providing legal support throughout project execution- Managing variations, amendments, and claims- Conducting legal risk analyses and assessments- Supporting the management of guarantees and securities, including bank guarantees- Working closely with Project Management and Finance- Managing and coordinating external law firms- Ensuring compliance with applicable German law, including the German Civil Code (BGB), VOB/B, and FIDIC contractual standardsYour Profile- You are a fully qualified German lawyer (Volljurist) with the required legal qualifications for the position- Strong knowledge of contract law and the ability to understand and handle complex legal matters- 5–10+ years of professional experience in construction law, infrastructure law, or a related field- Proven experience with EPC contracts- Experience in claims management- Strong commercial and business understanding- Fluent English skillsWhat We Offer- Exciting large-scale projects in the fields of BESS and high-voltage infrastructure- Direct interaction with grid operators- A high level of responsibility and professional independence- Attractive compensation and opportunities for professional development- Long-term career prospects within an international and growing companyPlease send your complete application documents to: careers@promergon.com (https://mailto:careers@promergon.com)Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Zwingend erforderlich: Vertragsgestaltung, Vertragsausarbeitung, Vertragsrecht, Bau- und Architektenrecht

required.- Proficiency in English (written and spoken).------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Ihre jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASFIf you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in.Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place.WHAT YOU CAN EXPECTSurventis became an independent company on 30 June 2026. jobs.description: Your mission Join InnolumeAt Innolume, we develop innovative optoelectronic semiconductor technologies that power next-generation communication and sensing applications worldwide.To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced Software Engineer (f/m/d) who will work across our locations in Eindhoven and Dortmund and is comfortable traveling regularly between both sites.In this role, you will modernize our software landscape, develop scalable applications, and connect software with laboratory and manufacturing equipment. Your work will directly support the development and production of cutting-edge photonic semiconductor devices while helping shape the next generation of our digital engineering environment.If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and want to see your software making a tangible impact in a high-tech manufacturing environment, we would love to meet you.Build the Software behind tomorrow's Semiconductor Technology:• Design, develop and maintain software for automated measurement, equipment control and data acquisition• Build scalable desktop applications and software architectures for engineering and manufacturing• Modernise legacy software applications and migrate existing LabVIEW solutions to sustainable software platforms• Integrate laboratory instruments, manufacturing equipment, databases, MES and ERP systems• Develop reliable software interfaces and efficient data pipelines• Improve software quality, maintainability and performance using modern engineering principles• Troubleshoot complex software-hardware interactions in close collaboration with engineering teams• Work closely with Production, Process Engineering, Quality and IT to deliver reliable software solutions• Contribute to the digital transformation of semiconductor manufacturingYour profile• Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering or a related technical field• Several years of professional software development experience• Strong programming skills in Python and/or C# (C++ is an advantage)• Solid understanding of Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development workflows• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills• Fluent English language skills (spoken and written)Nice to have• German language skills are an advantage• Experience with laboratory automation or industrial software• Experience integrating laboratory instruments or manufacturing equipment• Knowledge of MES, ERP or industrial communication interfaces• Experience migrating legacy software systems• Familiarity with Industry 4.0, process monitoring, or machine learning• Experience in the semiconductor industryWhy us?What we offer:• Exciting software projects in a highly innovative semiconductor environment• The opportunity to shape a modern software platform with long-term impact• An international, interdisciplinary team with flat hierarchies• Short decision-making paths and a collaborative working culture• Professional development and continuous learning opportunities• Flexible working hours and an attractive compensation packageJoin Innolume and help us develop the software that powers the next generation of photonic semiconductor technologies.Career starters, graduates, and candidates with initial professional experience are encouraged to apply.?We look forward to receiving your application.Please send your complete application documents to jolanta.rzesa@innolume.comInnolume GmbHKonrad-Adenauer-Allee 11 | 44263 Dortmundwww.innolume.comAbout usInnolume is an internationally operating specialist for GaAs-, InAs- & InP-based laser diodes. jobs.occupation: Ausbildung 2027 zum zum Kunststoff- und Kautschuktechnologen (m/w/d) Kunststofffenster (Kunststoff- und Kautschuktechnologe/-technologin - Halbzeuge)
jobs.description: Training in 2027 to become a process mechanic for plastics and rubber technologyprofine ist eine eigentümergeführte Unternehmensgruppe, die weltweit Kunststoffprofile für Fenster und Haustüren, Sichtschutz-Systeme und PVC-Platten herstellt. Mit unseren drei Marken KBE, KÖMMERLING und TROCAL sowie dem leidenschaftlichen Einsatz unserer 3.000 Mitarbeiter schaffen wir weltweit in 23 Ländern Qualität und Vertrauen.Zum 01.08.2027 suchen wir am Standort Pirmasens Auszubildende zum Kunststoff- und Kautschuktechnologen (m/w/d).AUFGABEN UND TÄTIGKEITENDie Ausbildung findet in der Fachrichtung Kunststofffenster statt.Als Kunststoff- und Kautschuktechnologe in der Fachrichtung Kunststofffenster übernimmst du vielfältige Aufgaben in der Fertigung und Montage von Fenster-, Tür- und Fassadenelementen aus polymeren Werkstoffen.Dabei berücksichtigst du wichtige Aspekte wie Wärmeschutz, Lärmschutz, Oberflächengestaltung und Einbruchschutz. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehört auch das Durchführen von Aufmaßtätigkeiten und Auftragsbesprechungen sowie das Anwenden von technischen Zeichnungen. Du erstellst Zusammenbauzeichnungen und Detailskizzen und planst Fertigungs- und Montageabläufe und wählst geeignete Fenstersystemkomponenten aus.Im Team oder selbstständig arbeitest du kunden- und prozessorientiert und führst Fehleranalysen durch, um die Produktion kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Zusätzlich wirkst du aktiv bei der Planung und Optimierung von Fertigungsprozessen mit.Durch die vielseitigen Einsatzmöglichkeiten und Aufgabengebiete bietet dir der Beruf des Kunststoff- und Kautschuktechnologen für Kunststofftechnik ausgesprochen gute Zukunftsperspektiven.AUSBILDUNG IM HAUSE- Grundausbildung Metall- Grundausbildung Kunststoff- Elektrotechnik- Pneumatik/Hydraulik- Technische Kommunikation- Projektarbeit- Extrusion- Mischerei- Qualitätswesen- ModellfensterbauIN DER BERUFSSCHULE- Werkstoffkunde- Verfahrenstechnik- Technische Mathematik- Technische Kommunikation- Wirtschaftslehre/Kommunikation- Qualitätsmanagement- Deutsch- Steuer- und RegelungstechnikWEITERBILDUNGSMÖGLICHKEITEN:Industriemeister/-inTechnischer Betriebswirt/-inTechniker/-inWIR BIETENATTRAKTIVE AUSBILDUNGSVERGÜTUNGBei uns erhälst du im ersten Ausbildungsjahr 1.000 €, im zweiten 1.100 € und im dritten 1.200 € pro Monat. Zusätzlich zahlen wir Urlaubs- & Weihnachtsgeld.KARRIERECHANCENprofine bildet aus, um zu übernehmen – diese Philosophie setzen wir konsequent um. Zudem bieten wir hervorragende Aufstiegschancen, was ein Blick in unsere Führungsebene verdeutlicht.NACHHALTIGKEITDu möchtest für ein Unternehmen arbeiten, das seine ökologische und soziale Verantwortung ernst nimmt? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.LERNEN IM TEAMUnsere Ausbildungsberufe sind immer mehrfach besetzt und wir fördern den Teamgedanken mit vielen Veranstaltungen wie unserem Teamcamp oder Grillfest.URLAUBS- UND WEIHNACHTSGELDZusätzlich zum normalen Ausbildungsgehalt, bekommst du Urlaubs- sowie Weihnachtsgeld. Darüber hinaus hast du 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr.Für uns kommen Bewerber aus dem gesamten Bundesgebiet, sowie dem Ausland in Frage.Hinweis für Bewerber aus dem Ausland.Bei Bewerbern aus dem Ausland sollten bereits grundlegende Deutschkenntnisse auf B1 Niveau vorhanden sein. Wir akzeptieren Ihre Bewerbungsunterlagen auch in Englisch.Wir unterstützen Sie am Anfang bei notwendigen Behördengängen und helfen Ihnen bei der Wohnungssuche.Es steht Ihnen für alle Fragen der Integration bei Bedarf in der ersten Zeit ein Ansprechpartner zur Verfügung.Important note for foreign applicants:You have the opportunity to translate the job offer into your native language.Please use your internet browser's translation toolNote for applicants from abroad.Applicants from abroad should already have basic German skills at B1 level. jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Betriebswirt - Personal*Stellenbeschreibung:Team Menz ist spezialisiert auf die Herstellung komplexer Baugruppen mit fortschrittlichen Stanz- und Biegetechniken sowie Oberflächenveredelungsverfahren wie Gleitschleifen, Strahlen und Teilereinigung.Wir sind bestrebt, unseren Kunden qualitativ hochwertige Produkte anzubieten, und unser Team von 90 qualifizierten Fachkräften arbeitet unermüdlich daran, ihre Erwartungen zu erfüllen und zu übertreffen.Während wir weiter wachsen und unsere Geschäftstätigkeiten ausbauen, suchen wir neue Talente, die unser Team in Deutschland verstärken und uns helfen, unsere Ziele zu erreichen.Senior Bürokauffrau/mann (m/f/d) - Festanstellung, VollzeitStellenbeschreibungWir suchen einen erfahrenen und vielseitigen Senior Bürokauffrau / Bürokaufmann, der/die als zentrale Anlaufstelle für sämtliche Verwaltungs- und Unterstützungsprozesse innerhalb unseres Unternehmens fungiert. The Leibniz-Institut für Analytische Wissenschaften - ISAS - e. V. develops efficient analytical methods for health research. Thus, it contributes to the improvement of the prevention, early diagnosis, and therapy of diseases like cardiovascular diseases or cancer. Overall, the institute strives to advance precision medicine by combining knowledge from different fields such as biology, chemistry, computer science, medicine, pharmacology, and physics. ISAS is a member of the Leibniz Association and is publicly funded by the Federal Republic of Germany and its federal states.We invite applications for the Research Group Biofluorescence: PhD candidate (f/m/d)This project, funded by the DFG as part of CRC 1752, "DYNAMO: Immediate Tumor Dynamics in Melanoma Therapy“ (https://www.uni-due.de/crc1752/) seeks to combine high-resolution multi-omics profiling, advanced computational modeling, and clinically aligned biomarker stratification, in order to generate actionable, patient-specific predictions and resistance-targeting interventions in melanoma therapy. You will be responsible for finding out the role of neutrophils for the early development of therapy resistance in human melanoma. The project is being carried out in collaboration with University Hospital Essen and the University of Duisburg-Essen.You will be responsible for- Experimental setup and execution of neutrophil functional profiling in the context of melanoma immune regulation and immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) response- Functional assays of neutrophils including migration, phagocytosis, and ROS production- Optimization and standardization of neutrophil functional assays for primary human samples- Few-cell proteomics for deep molecular characterization of neutrophil subsets- Multicolor flow cytometry of PBMCs and immune cell populations- Live-cell imaging and advanced microscopy for dynamic immune cell behavior analysis- Planning and execution of stimulation and inhibition experiments to dissect signaling pathways regulating neutrophil function in the melanoma context- Data processing, analysis, interpretation, and visualization of experimental results in collaboration with computational partnersYour profile- Completed diploma or master’s degree in molecular biology, cancer biology, immunology, cell biology, bioinformatics, translational medicine or related disciplines- Experience in molecular and cellular biology techniques, ideally with hands-on experience with functional immune cell assays (preferably with neutrophils or myeloid cells) is an advantage- Strong interest in melanoma biology, tumor immunology, immune checkpoint therapy, translational cancer research, and tumor–immune interactions- Experience with cell culture, flow cytometry, microscopy, proteomics workflows or high-dimensional immune profiling approaches is desirable- Experience with bioinformatics or biostatistics is beneficial but not required- Ability to work independently and in interdisciplinary teams, with strong organizational skills and analytical thinking- High level of self-motivation, scientific curiosity, reliability, creativity, and team-oriented personality with enthusiasm to work in a collaborative research environment- Fluent in spoken and written EnglishWe offer- A clear research topic as well as multifold training and support for PhD students in framework of ISAS and the Leibniz association- Opportunities for scientific training and development in an international environment and an excellent working atmosphere in a very dynamic and professional team- Access to state-of-the-art technologies including few-cell proteomics, high-dimensional flow cytometry, and advanced microscopy platforms- Integration into an interdisciplinary, internationally visible, translation-oriented cancer immunology research network- The opportunity to present your data on international conferences and participate in workshops- A wide range of opportunities for further training and qualifications- Flexible working times, mobile working and attractive social benefits- Family-friendly infrastructure and support from a family serviceNon-residents who apply for this job will receive help from the institute to find accommodation and to handle authorities. Applications from disabled applicants are welcome. ISAS supports the principle of equal opportunity for all employees and therefore particularly encourages women to apply.The part-time position (65%) starts on October 1, 2026, and is offered until June 30, 2030. The salary will be according to the German TV-L and falls within the pay group 13. The time limitation of the contract is based on the Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz (WissZeitVG).ISAS collects and processes the personal data of its applicants in accordance with European and German legal regulations. Further information on data protection and the processing of personal data can be found at: https://www.isas.de/en/datenschutz.The closing date for applications is** August 14, 2026**. Please apply via our applicant portal (https://bewerbermanagement.net/en/jobposting/4e342c0b4ebdda805ec07aefc033c1e6bce0d9010/apply?ref=Agentur+f%C3%BCr+Arbeit+Dortmund) . If you have any questions (reference number 411_2026), feel free to contact the Human Resources team (bewerbungen@isas.de). Further information about the institute can be found at: https://www.isas.de/en.

In the Focus hospital ranking, the UKB ranks first among university hospitals in North Rhine-Westphalia and second nationwide in terms of case mix index (case severity). In 2024, the UKB raised nearly €100 million in third-party funding for research, development, and teaching. The F.A.Z. Institute has named the UKB “Germany’s Training Champion” and “Germany’s Most Attractive Employer” for the fourth consecutive year.The following full-/part-time position (38.5/19.5 hours per week)  is to be filled as soon as possible in the Institute for Hygiene and Public Health, Section Global Child Health of the University Hospital Bonn:Scientific coordinator (m/f/d)The Section of Global Child Health was established in November 2025 with the appointment of the Endowed Professorship in Global Child Health. and non-academic partners- Management of communication channels between institutions, disciplines, and countries, ensuring efficient information flow and alignment of activities- Coordination, and
